Snow can be so quiet but today it was loud and boisterous and craving attention. Amazing how such a simple act of snow falling creates a unique unending cacophony of sound. Made for some very annoying we hiking / climbing conditions but incredibly memorable and happy memory. Thank you drew for being one of the only people I could truly enjoy a fucked up day like this with. Sorry about your back, your survivability is top notch. This climb was kinda wet and despite terrible skin sheer desire saw me to the top.
Another great day at Black. All I can think about is Sans.

What an enjoyable end to the climbing day. Nom nom another mantle in my belly! Pretty wild hop into a left hand fliparino press. Start hold is so going to rip-arino. Marcus finding a micro crimp to avoid the beastly mantle. So apparently you either have to be a Grecian God with amazing pressing powers or SoCal Royalty with insane crimping powers. Thanks Marcus, Woo and Kevin for another wonderful day on the Mountain. Lets start later next time kay? Also getting home an 1:30 is rooouuugh.

Agreed, definitely flash-able, I just didn't lolz.  Really need to start warming up properly. Third go. Consider this a quick temperature reading that I'm not 100% today... oh well.  Speaking of temperature, this season between spring and summer is rough... have I really forgotten what "hot" feels like? Historically my most climbed months were June and July... but the 70 degrees of today felt MISERABLE. We didn't even get to the Gate until 3:30 so I thought it would feel okay. Damn I'm a spoiled little beezy. That morning hike with Sear Woo got me tired. We did bag #10 and #7 of Pikes Peaks which was neat. The run to the car ripped a big blister on my heal which was not nice in a climbing shoe. I got so thirsty today I had to ask SoCal Royalty for water, I never get thirsty. 6 Sanzos were not sufficient for Morning Hike + Climb day. Oh climb right! This things is real fun, quality power on nice holds. Wish it was still cooler and I think I would have flashed.

Really cool scoops! And super close to pride. Shoutout Woo for the proper read. Also shoutout Kevin for the psych to try! ...but not shoutout for bringing two left shoes LOL! Especially after our conversation about how hard it is to tell old and new Instincts apart. Awesome Parallax gully scope session! Lots of crazy rock here. Woo lets rope that Gold Arete. SoCal Royalty lets rope that Gold Behemoth you found. Also stoked to get on "Sincerely Yours", next trip boys! OOOH also I'm, low-key-high-key stoked on "It Takes a Village" and think I have top out beta. Whos with me!? I obviously cant do it alone.

Here again down at Howls to support Ishmael, should be an easy clean up for him... NOT! Poor boy. During warm up he both broke Howls (don't worry still goes) and then filleted his finger. What an impressive climbing day. We thought maybe his gushing flapper on the second digit would not be as much of an issue on Vorpal, but well bleeders be bleeders. Hard to push both physically and mentally when you have pain and blood lubrication. Sorry my guy.

Anyway, since I'm here again I started window shopping for FAs. Last time I looked at that rad compression impossible top out through the cave, but this week I was looking at the Projects labeled "40" in the book. The left side of the wall had some irresistible features, plus we had the pads, and drew couldn't climb anymore soooo figured id work her. I felt like Michaelangelo as I used gallons of chalk cleaning and painting this boy. Such a techy beauty in this FA. Tons of good right/down facing holds and bad feet. Took quite a while to find the beta but felt mellow (V4?) once I had my sequence, however delicate scary crux is up high. Another banger for the Corral Highball Circuit! The right side of the face is next!!

Me: "Check out Style!?"
Me: "URRRHTTTTT!", "BURRRRHT!"
Drew: Hell yeah Davey!, Dang that was totally inspiring!"
Me:"WOOOOOOHHHOOOOOOOO!"
Me: "That climb is fucking NUTS!"
Me: "Did you check out my style?"
Drew: "Yeah, what did you want me to do with your style?".
Me: "What the FUCK!?"

Top tier world class boulder. Hard a tits and should probably be V9, but if you have sufficient body dimensions this is an absolute must do. Wow. Several trips back and forth to Howl's for extra pads were... fun. SO close.. but so far away... Chase I wanted to call you when I sent this but I felt guilty... you know you being a dad now and all and not being able to get out here. Love ya and miss ya buddy.

HOLY SHIT this was my 200th V8! What unintentional cosmic luck!!

I don't actually think this is what I did. What I did was start on "Chillin' like Bob Dylan" and go into "Chillin' left" which was rather chillin. Started on the obvious feature and climbed through the obvious feature... sometimes my sport embarrasses me. But you know I love it. Cosmic coincidence is strong today. First people I ran into (ignoring Mountain King Encounters) in the last 6 weeks was on this super super popular climb.... PLUS then Kevin goes home to Mr Dylan in his house? I know there is a thing called confirmation bias, but dang that's some conscious universe having fun. Now I have to go back for the real "Chillin' like Bob Dylan". To be fair, this was very fun, rad cross into the knobarino.

I really wonder if anyone has done this since the guidebook. Cool features, but a real piece of wonk with a big wonky yeet. Thanks Kevin for psyching me up for these 1 star blue tags. Would not have tried without you. In fact, shout out your psyche in general, having you and John out here today made it much more special for me and Akhil. Thanks my dudarinos. By "big wonky yeet" I mean this is a dyno, and an awkward one at that, but still fun. Top was actually wonk too. Impossible to grade. I need some love. The loving kind. Not the not loving kind.

Marcus is a bonafide wizard. How does he keep finding stellar rock so close to the road. Kody and I like adventuring too much apparently. How dare you torture me with my 8a addiction by not logging this. I was dying of 8a thirst. I guess this really is a thirst trap. Anyway, this thing is so good. Great rock quality with cool holds. There is a slightly annoying pedestal rock you need to avoid but really really great addition. I was not planning on doing this today bc I didn't want to snake an FA; I'm not on Instagram these days so I did know Marcus and Kody did it literally 2 dats ago. Luckily Kevin saw the post, but he didn't know where the boulder was. I knew where the boulder was. With our powers combine.... Sploosh.
Uh oh Gregor learned how to crimp.
This slab is so good. Glad we got AK up this for that days climbed metric.

#31 pg 65. Wonderful final mantle. Bottom has cool holds but they climb a bit unenjoyably. Not too much so, but enough to merit less action. That and the name sucks... why not something like "Grillin' with Mr Dylan"? That goes. Unnamed is the worst. Thank you Sear for getting AK down here (Happy Bday you old man in his 30s), and thanks AK for a wonderful weekend. So great having you and sharing some thoughts experiences and emotions. You were much appreciated. Especially that prompt on my dating profile. That was hot shit. I have never been so outclassed. You wit and charm are next level... no wonders I'm so single. Also Thank you Nate for coming down, it was weird to have you not sleep on the couch. Nice to meet you GF, she rad. Gets the Grecian God stamp of approval. I am so beat from another exhausting weekend.. hopefully work the week won't be multiple 12 hour days... =/.

SOCAL ROYALTY LOG YOUR NEW FAS I WANT TO LOG

The small compression block opposite Neolithic Thirst Trap. Naturally all compression blocks invoke images of refrigerators, but well this is too small to be a proper refrigerator so a toaster is more apt. Funner and harder than I expected: start sitting, work up a bit then make a big ol' move to the top sloper. Try not to ass rocket on the stump.

Kinda disappointed by this one, especially after thinking I did it last week. It's okay and movement was decent once Kody sprayed me down. Before being sprayed I was trying to just campus with presses if you can imagine how ridiculous that looks. Feels forced and cutting left is way more intuitive - when you have a honking knob that honk-able you use it to the fullest. At least my feet are hot.

Giving this the upgrade for sure. Took 5 of use a bit to find workable beta. I was able to actualize a right hand near the top by simply pretending hard enough. Drew just used his lank. Kody proving you can Bang-On on a slab and hold your breath the whole while. Shoutout the whole crew today: Drew, Me, Kody, Katie Bae, Foley, Carole, Nate and Katherine. Thank you for another memorable Black Mountain experience. Katie Bae I'm so sorry I didn't fix the crease in the pad when I though of it.. I would have saved you so much pain and hassle. Curious what beta you used Kevin. 12 O'clock still hard as nails... plus drew ripped off a hold lol. Good spot Kody. We have the beta though it will go!

Actually pretty good. The mantle shelf is at such an enjoyable angle. I do prefer a stiffer mantle myself, but that doesn't make me appreciate this one any less. First move was also enjoyable. Perfect crimp for the left hand an a righteous imaginary hold for the right.  Let the obscure rampage BEGIN. So good seeing Kody after all this time!

Starting this thing is like playing Russian roulette. I thought for sure the hold was gonna shatter on me, but  alas, the revolver spun empty barreled. Even Drew pulled on it with his fat ass. I don't mind climbing in a crevice, and even though it's super short the moves are good.

I'm so bad at grading. Oh well. That's Kodys problem. Which is actually kind of my problem because I am looking forward to trundling the mountain with you getting volume like no one has ever seen! Anyway this climb is decent. Drew broke two holds on this as well... actually when examining the book closer, either we did NOT do "Tia's Slab" or the bubble for climb #47 on pg 77 (photo less climb on 82) is incorrectly placed. The climb we did was on the same boulder as Kindered Spirits. Getting closer to sticking the jump on Sans!!! Stoked for the road to open and start evening sessions. I am physically incapable of resting all day If there be rocks.

#9 pg 62. Man I have a tough time giving things 1 star, and I don't even know if I am capable of 0 starts. Anyway, for a star pile this is more enjoyable than I expected. Its got some features, and I could see someone liking this. Almost forgot to log this. I like watchings Drews reaction as Kody and I keep doing these insane climbs lolol.

#25 pg 64. That was quite the uncomfortable assembly but honestly it went rather well. Very glad. It makes more sense why Kody was walking towards me in retrospect lol. Anyway, this climb is quite good. A bit annoying at the beginning, but jugs virtually the whole way. The bad landing makes it real, real fast. Loved that I didn't expect the cross, but well, I crossed. Chefs kiss. A worthwhile highball indeed. Drew did not need to cross.

#15 pg 63. A jump, a campus, a casual mantle? Its okay. Nothing to write home about. Today turning into quite a fun chillax day. Bishop crew brining a lot of enjoyable psyche. Rare to find people who can just enjoy climbing, especially uninspiring lines that Kody and I keep doing lol. Hope everyone had an amazing trip!

#20 pg 64. Yes another V4 "Unnamed Face". This is WHY boulders should never be left unnamed and why I have no qualms with people just creating names, even if they are NOT the FA. Sorry 8a for adding more clutter to your system, but you really should make a better way to distinguish climbs like this. ESPECIALLY ones that have a guidebook entry. I will try to always indicate what problem from the guide,. Anyway enough ranting. This climb starts decently: it is a pad stack / jump but it has a good starting hold which is accompanied by these cool pods as feet. Once you get up there you just use your lank to grab a friable crimp removing any semblance of aesthetic climbing.,
#14 pg 63. I did this in a un-ideal way, but it showed off my high step ability. This gets its 3rd star bc you can top out following that amazing feature even though it's only class 4 up there.

I really think I would enjoy living in bishop, even in these slightly off season months. Had a 2 hour window after work and before sauna. Made it from Kelsey's front door to "Less Poetry Please" in 25 minutes. Plus I also love adventuring and would be stoked on some alpine bouldering / exploring. Thank you Kelsey for making this sort of trip possible: your new house is beyond amazing. And just having this mental, physical and emotional break from my normal bubble has been so refreshing. This climb is okay, almost good in a few ways, but its in next to so many all star lines that it feels a bit dumpy. I did like that it tops out on that cool shelf. So close on my longtime project "Less Poetry Please" but this pile will have to do for my Days Climbed Metric.

Sendoff climbing weekend for our precious little Drewbie. Stoked to finally check out this area. I wish there was better information on this area, but its also fun to just scope and climb whatever looks the most fun, oblivious of grade. This thing is good with incredible rock quality. Relatively easy for tall folks.. kind of a heaven story. Most things seem reachy lol. The way I did it, the crux was an enjoyable tension move when cutting the left foot.

PRNF. AKA "The Smucking Fear" Project.  The vision on this one was one move lower, starting on both under clings with an insanely frustrating smear to gain the good right facing edge. But alas, after stomping the ground enough times gave up and started one move in. The difficulty is more consistent from here anyway. Located on the West side of "The Eleventh Hour" boulder, still on the same north face. Start left hand underling, right hand about head height on a right facing edge. Make some rather techy moves, eventually reaching the obvious jug feature. Another fun reach straight up for there gets you to good enough holds to mantle up. The Eleventh Hour is hard, but one of the most inspiring lines ever. Definitely the king line of heaven. Woo sussing the slab for us, mantle actually wasnt that hard, but of course we were on rope. Seems terrifying sans. Will be stoked to come back here in a year or so with more crimp strength and more pads. If you know the meaning behind this name, you are likely a sandbox member. Could possibly be an FA but I  doubt it.

PRNF. Constant high alpine elevation headache. Energy almost completely sapped, lots of sun and just heaven is a lot physically emotionally and mentally. Anyway this climb is located here, 37°17'09.6"N 118°38'57.7"W, just to the right of the trail, before you get to the eleventh hour. North east corner of that boulder start on incredible under clings and do a fun arete sequence to get better holds up high. Landing is a bit awk, with the back rock and small rock in the landing but its a good climb. Boys don't forget so scope good logs on the way down!!

PRNF. Pretty sure most everything in heaven has been climbed, that being said I refuse to log everything as N.N. so I will be making temporary names for the climbs I cannot find. For any regulars to my ridiculous log book I use the tag PRNF to indicate this is a "Pending Real Name Found" Log. Woo with the vision on this beauty while the rest of us threw ourselves at that ridiculous span piece. Great sad that I could not send, was stoked on my ninja kick out of full span toe hook. Anyway, this is an east facing vertical face here (37°17'10.7"N 118°39'01.4"W), It is basically midway between the "Cracked Boulder" and "The Mustache Ride" , but this particular boulder or route is not listed on MP.  Start on the right side of the face, stepping / squatting off the other rock. Start is obvious horizontal holds with nice feet. Some nice technical face moves left into an enjoyable crux DP to the good incut.

PRNF. Located here 37°17'12.6"N 118°38'57.7"W just uphill from Gimme Shelter. Start on the south facing over hanging face on obvious head high incut crimps. Big move to the lip followed by a lovely mantle. Don't forget to look to your right at heavenly expanse. Bouldering back drops don't get better than this. I cant believe I had more fun day 2, thought I would have been too beat but it turned out to be such an insane day. I already mentioned jacking off with the boys, Jenny and Paul, sorry drew for getting your frame temporarily stuck, opted to not go the live music thinggy which was probably a good thing considering. Thank you Kelsey for hugs. Those were needed.

Since the V11 broke I guess you just have to do the amazing V3 highball as an amazing V3 highball instead. Amazing rock and big holds up to no hands rest into a surprisingly scary move out of the depression. Wowo i think I was up there for several minutes before I was able to settle my heart and lock in a foot sequence I felt comfortable with. So good. VSad that I was not able to pull the right arete entrance into this top out. Kody has one of the best visions I've ever seen. And Woo has one of the most amazing last minute, focused try hards I've ever seen.

PRNF. The southmost face of the "Gimme Shelter" Boulder AKA "The Orange Slab" Boulder on MP. This has definitely been done before, you can tell bc people at heaven are landing building masters... that being said they got NOTHING on our crew. First time bringing a car jack to the boulders to help clear a landing for those pecky heavy and/or wedged boulders. The roof underneath this climb is RAD and will be a great addition to Heaven now that it can can be climbed pleasantly without dabbing. I am sad for Drew that we wasn't able to put her down, but this experience is a wonderful memory. The team efforts to move those boulders was a highlight of the trip. Don't forget to always bring a Grecian God to manhandle rocks of all sizes. I think this is only boulder that all 5 of us did.. well except Rami's face, butt tits still an apt moment to shout out the crew: Kody, SoCal Royalty, Woo, ImATinyMan and myself. A whole bunch of almost misshaps on this trips contributing to amazing first time to heaven: flat tires, almost empty tanks, stuck foresters.  We also so Jenny and Paul which was NUTTS. Fun face moves into a big span to better holds.

Despite hating unnamed, I actually don't think I want to even PRNF climbs here.  Thanks Kyle for showing us this, some beautiful sunset climbing while a bit tipsy was just what we needed. Heavy emotions the last few days. Weeding with some craft cocktails was a highlight of today. Oh also Dennys, that was a loot ending. Anyway, did this climb barefoot for some reason and my foot blew on the flash so SG i guess. West Corner up some cool holes.
The uphill thing with undecling / fin feature. I hear frogs!
Trav on the back side. Left to Right. Some loose rock toward the end.
Awesome holds directly up to join the beautiful lip trav. That cotton wood jizz on my car is certainly not ideal lol. Can't see anything.
Whoa. I did not flash. back corner with transition form good holds to high foot an arete was enjoyable.
The most striking line in this area, long easy aesthetic traverse. I am making up grades. But grades are made up so who cares.

A quick morning in the ice caves with Kelsey before the sun starts melting our faces. Had a new first. That was nice. Also tried Mecha Streisand again but failed. I think I have the beta for next time tho!!! stay tuned!

Reporting in as Oldest Brother Gomberg today. Spewing sage advice to my youngers. What an amazing day with the fam, I had such a good time. Make choices little ones. Also catch Swedeish Swimmers with your mouth and pass it on, that's the secret to a long and health life. HERPES! So glad I sent this today because days climbed metric was at risk. Redemption bc I broke my wrist on this several years ago thinking I didn't need pads... ALSO the hottest thing on my mind right now is HARRY POTHEAD. I punted the mantle and missed my pads. Possibly my most embarrassing moment ever.  It rivals the legendary Brian's project punt. I was already writing my 8a comment in my head when my left heel popped: totally bewildered I realized I was on the ground. The starting crimp sliced a hole in my finger so quite regrettably I must save harry pothead for another day. Back to this climb, drew did this twice in a row in this chacos to make me feel good. But actually thanks for the support, would not have sent this without your encouragement. I'm going to miss you so much.

The OG Butterfly Effect I did in 2015 from a high start and graded it V5. From the OG start its a single low prob move and damn, that move is still low prob 9 years later. Upgrading the high start to V6 is probably fair. I think this start is probably more natural, but it does add a bit of difficult, mostly due to the fact that you cant set up quite as perfectly for the big move as you can from the ground. For this Mid Start, start left hand on the sharp incut crack crimp, where your foot goes for the big move; right hand on the good opposing hold about chest height.

I REALLY wanted to do the full sit and was SO CLOSE, but I sliced my middle finger on my left hand. The full sit is the true line and is sick. I will be back. I repeated The Monarch as I always do when up here and that line is still king. Chefs Kiss. There was still like 4 feet of snow here which was a bit unreal. Luckily the boulders generate so much heat that there was a 5 foot swath around each boulder making climbing quite enjoyable.

This was highly not great. But another new one for MK and my first new one of the year. On the Monarch Boulder, on the south face, start on the left corner on two opposing crimps. Holds on the left side are of sub par quality. Crux is pulling on, not pulling out if you believe that. Move to some good albeit crumbly holds. The one on the left face has a cool shape, but that's about it.

On the south side of the Orange Succubus Boulder. Start on the left side of the jug rail, left hand on a cool flat pinch crimp, right hand on the jug rail, and right heel also on the jug rail. Move to a right facing hold then make a no joke yeet to the horny lip. Then make sweet sweet love. Speaking of sweet sweet love, I started "A Court of Roses and Thorns", well finished, but that is not smut. Lets call it Virign Smut, shoutout Alexandra. I was prepared for way dirtier. This climb would be better if it wasn't forced, from the jug rail you can move easily exit right. See next problems.

This is confusingly hard. I think the positioning makes you think its not overhung but it really is. Start high on a right hand pinch, and a high left hand crimp. Move up and slightly right to gain the lip. I traversed a bit right from there to make the mantle easier. The west facing face is quite pretty with its orange/black patina. The west face "might" go. If it does it will be very very hard. Fun solo hike out here. Amazingly its only 3 miles via the old Indian trail to Lower Monarch Lake. Sync up with Eileen and Pike on my way down. Pike serenading us with his instrument there. Not in a kinky way. He brought his guitar to Groundhog Meadow. (GPS: 36.456449, -118.566526).

On the south side of the Orange Succubus Boulder start on the right side of the cool jug rail. Slap up then ride the lip left a bit until you can mantle. Its a nice mantle. Think of Tamlin, Fayra and there sweet sweet tender love making. Might be a tad harder than 2?
Do it again but go right. Maybe Reislin will be more fun.

One of two main attractions on the Full Breach Boulder (GPS: 36.457534, -118.625450). Start at the base of the sharp arete and climb straight up, slapping out right to the opposing arete once you can. This has been such a different but wonderful trip with my wittle nieces! Both so cute. I love that Lenora is so silly to me and cutely refuses to let me carry her when asked OR when asking her for a strawberry she gives it to everyone except me. lol.

Not great, but it is the path of least resistance. Shoutout Hannah Ritchie. This is on the Full Breach Boulder (GPS: 36.457534, -118.625450). Start at the base of the sharp arete on a good leftward and slightly down facing good hold and huge feet. Ignore the beautiful sharp arete and cut left onto the easy slap. Shame on you.
ascents.zlaggableName: Not The End Of The World

ascents.comment: A great V0 near the Atwell Mill Campround. Eileen and I were searching for the Sierra Nevada Indian Baths that are here and when I saw this boys Xeno and crack system I just had to blow my load. This is so obvious I bet it was done by some intrepit native years and years and years ago, so I will not claim FA. You happy Adam Burch!? Somewhere around here? (GPS: 36.463625, -118.668479). So happy our favorite Sequoia recovered form the big fires. Praise Be! Also that Indian Bath was way cooler than expected. And closer to the trail than expected. Even somewhere you have been so so many times still has little mysteries and secrets to reveal.

The main attraction on the Full Breach Boulder, down hill corner, following the main arete up until you can span to the Full Breach Arete with great releif. (GPS: 36.457534, -118.625450). Delicate start, into an unexpected sequence, and some rather spicy redpoint cruxing. Landing is NOT flat and there is potential to roll an extra 50 ft to the road. I started very high on a right hand something on the right facing shelf, left hand pretty low on a small sharp crimp in a crack. Definitely potential for a full sit which would be rad. So STOKED to finally see someone else in MK with a crash pad!! Shoutout Kyle. Ill get you some primitive topos eventually

Might be V7. So hard with a consensus of 1.  South face of the boulder, right side. The left hand is like Rich Creamery Butter (read that like Kate and Leopold) thx Hugh Jackman. It's a perfectly sculpted head high sloper. For the right hand use a 3.5 finger crimp pocket thing also head high. Pull on and do a sweet DP up and left to a perfectly placed edge. Only time I used my floodlight this trip. Thanks Aaron for the spot and psyche. Got a gorgeous shot with the moonset in the distance. The name is bc that show / book is relevant in pop culture right now AND that there are 3 glacially deposited boulders on this section of sunset rock. This is the third of them so shoutout glacial magic for this third beautiful body.

Oh lordy. This feature completely floored me. A vertical face is topped with a triangle shaped roof jutting 3 feet straight horizontally, but here's the kicker: WHATS NEW PUSSYCAT!!! jk. The kicker is the two parts of the roof DO NOT TOUCH in the middle. They have a fist sized gap at the apex of the roof. And its lightening shape. Like what??! I started low bc it was possible, and turned out to be a surprisingly interesting lie back on the obvious ramp feature of the face. You can start at the very very bottom of the ramp, I started as if they were under clings bc there was a perfectly places foot to push into the eventual lie back. I struggled on this climbs name bc it would be world class anywhere and deserved a banger. Its kinds of like a double roof dihedral so I was gunning hard for book or library references, but after sitting on it for a while "Isekai" feels right.  Isekai is a subgenre of fantasy in which a character is suddenly transported from their world into a new or unfamiliar one. This is taken directly from Japanese Anime, and as you climb out of this double book magical roof dihedral it really is like you have been transported to another world.
I did this about 7 times today because its that good. This is the magical move. Take me away. Where is my Asuna?

Amazing V0 on a great and aesthetic rock in an absolutely stunning location. What a first FA Wendy Wilson! Start on the left facing feature in the center of the face and just go straight up through some awesome and huge edges. Aaron also managed to refine his beta and follow his daughter up! Thank Wilsons!

West face of the Nostalgia boulder, with a boulder in the landing (its actually still a safe landing). Start with a high right hand side pull and obvious opposing right foot. Pull on and move to some maybe reachy but cool holds. Shoutout those feels. I want someone to share life with. I love this place.

Pre break. Its actually better post break. On this go i started higher and had a crux first move to place the left foot above the bulge. I was using a friable right foot for this and well friable became fried. After that I pulled the friable mroe and it exposed some bigger cool holds which actually allowed a LOWER start. COOL!

Post Break. (GPS: 36.464836, -118.649797). South facing face, start on the big obvious edge on the right side of the face. One shouldery move gets you into slab climbing. For the Left variant, after getting established on the slab make a leftward traverse move into the obvious jugarino in the middle of the face. Continue up pulling out not down. Man the sun here is as brutal as that song from Olivia. I've never resonated so much with a 17 year old girl but damn some of her lyrics and feels slap. I felt like my shoes were melting. Name is shoutout to the profound feels MK inspires in me. It was my most emotional drive up the mountain, happy and menolcholy, peaceful and unquiet, content yet longing,  all at once.
Same start but go straight up. More enjoyable of the two, plus more POINTSSSSZZS.

Second Ascent after Wendy Wilson scores her second FA!! Stoked to climb with the Wilson family and see Wendy establish herself on this meaningful boulder. This climb starts on the left side of the face on a left facing edge under the arete. Move up to the arete then either mantle right there or more enjoyably work up and right to the opposing hold before pulling over (like the FA)

This had potential to be cool but it's basically one move. At least that move is squeezy. West face, right side., Start squeezing between the subtle dihedral and the aerte. I wanted to be able to start with right hand one lower, but it's just not quite good enough. Power up the wide feature rocking over right. Sip Sip that delicious pachyderm. Exquisite sunset and exquisite moonset here today.

So so so many tries. So its probably V7 but it doesn't feel like it should be. Its basically a span from one good hold or another. I thought it was going to be rad compression but the opposing holds don't offer enough. So span dear boys span. The starting hold is quite good and cool, but you get stuck under the bulge and its frustratingly hard to get high enough to reach the better holds. Start on the North West corner of the Nostalgia boulder, to the right of the tree, left hand high (~7 feet high) on a good edge and right on a bad opposing sidepull. Throw a bad heel up and keep bumping. There MIGHT be a shorter way to do it which involves sitting on that heal. I almost was able to get all my weight on it, but its just so bad that spanning was easier. What is also sad is i couldn't even span all the way to the jugs. I hit a "good enough" sloper and jsut pressed teh orange juice out of it.

Worst line on the boulder. Located on the west face toward the right side at the subtle dihedral. ,There are several coolish crimps shoulder height and lower, but then nada, then jugs. You probably could force a sit start but felt non enjoyable and rough. Started on a shoulder height crimp and one a foot or two lower. Pulled on then established on feet, then after looking for another hold, just popped to the jugs. Name is a shoutout to all the wonderful junipers growing on this beautiful rock. Reminds me of a worse sibling of the Solar Power boulder in Tahoe. A piece of granite on a really big piece of granite. Shoutout Wilsons (+Katia) for bringing some climbing stoke and making it an enjoyable evening.

Start on the left side of the concavity that is left of Yosemite Dreamin'. Stand into some underlings for a big span then compress up some edges. Name is shoutout the book recommended my Ms Lazarz. It brought me to tears. Im way more shaky these days and my mind and heart are less quiet. Nice to find another easy access boulder with some good lines! Last FA of this trip! Booyah that like 26 more climbs that no one will ever doo! Go me. Im so cool. Grecian God, Grecian God he's our man! If he can't do it no one can!

Never pulled onto this in the past bc the landing is too scary. But with sufficient pads and big strong Aaron Wilson there protecting me I did it. Quite good arete climbing. Decently barn doory at times. This is the right arete of the Cheese Wedge Boulder, staying on the left side of the arete. Glad that I brought enough pads for the peanut gallery to have a nice shaded cushion. Good job team scrambling up here! Maria, Katia, Wendy and Aaron.  <3

Better than I expected!! I thought it was going to be a silly standing press, with your arm already locked out, but aptly placed feed and a good left facing crimp allow you to sit start this mantle making it waaaay more enjoyable. How fun!

Another one hard to grade. Also I feel like I cheated and dreamt of Gorgonzola. The purest line I saw on this face was pure slab avoiding the aeries, but well I chickened out up high and used the left arete. Good slab/face moves low and I'm confident the full line goes but this boy has a scary landing requiring at least 4 pads and a spotter. It's not too hight but the landing is a granite chunk at like 45 degrees. I will eventually try sans gorgonzola in the future. I used the left arete after gaining the good right hand undercling/sidepull. This is the North face of the Cheese Wedge boulder which is in the Hugs For Gumby vicinity. Start on a chest high crimp in the center of the face. Honestly the Gumby area is the densest part of cold springs for sure my dudes. Thanks again Wilsons for accompanying me. It was nice to not climb alone. I like only climb alone out here, which is nice, but stoke is also nice.
ascents.zlaggableName: It's like you're dreamin' of Gorgonzola cheese when it's clearly Brie time, baby

ascents.comment: This arete will laugh you off the wall. Eat your wax covered cheese you peasants. Tried this thing probably 4 sessions over several years. Quite good. Blank ass feet, rounded arete with a few key spots. Start decently high on the right side of the arete and work up until you can grab that sweet top out jugarino. Glory.

Short one move but worthwhile. On the north facing face just north of the cheese wedge boulder. it's the boulder you are standing on when starting Cheese Wedge Arete V0. Start left hand in an undercling and right hand on a down pull. establish the pop to the very good lip. I also almost managed to go left hadn't first with a high left heel but the jump is easier. Oh yeah, don’t forget about the ripped apart deer that was underneath my beautiful tall face. Aaron would have yacked, and I feel like a death omen isn’t a good idea to try highballs.

Best v3 in MK (so far). Such a cool starting feature with enjoyable holds the whole way. Definitely should have taken Wendy to this one. In Faculty Flat, take the "Scott", "Nelson Sandidge", "Archer-Adney" turn and when  the road makes a big right hand turn to go up hill, break off the road heading left instead. Like 150 feet from that bend. Start on the obvious left facing granite plane feature, and right hand lower on an opposing undercling. Move up into some jugs, tack left to another good hold, then use a perfectly placed edge to execute yer mantley top. So glad I decided to add this boulder to my day. So good. Whiteclaw can be quite refreshing out here. Thanks Aaron. Might be faux pax to use the word Yosemite in MKs best v3 but well, we take that as a compliment. Get on this and let me know how sick.

Was not going to try this, but thank goodness Heartbreaker took Gus a few goes. Great temps today made this feel casual. Like way easier than Heartbreaker. Pretty darn awesome that that perfect starting rail sets up both a natural left and right exit which are wildly different. Next is Big  Dick Bills straight up finish. LEZZZZGO.

Honestly did not like this very much. But more climbs on a boulder. Did it two ways once using the crack hold up and left, once using the sloper up and right, I like the latter better but its def harder.

Book gives this V4 but the first move is pretty big and feet are bad. Probably about 4.5. Great meeting Gus today, thanks so much for touring. Alaska Crew is all time. Appreciate yalls so much. Like seriously, hospitality through the roof I felt so take care of. Look foreword to coming back to Anchorage!

Haven't touched real rock since early June so putting up pointz today felt GOOD. Nothing like a good ol sqwueeze to make me feel at home. Should have tried the low. Next time. Speaking of next time.... I'm tempted to move here. I really need to break out of some of my current bubbles and Anchorage is pretty high on the list RN.

Since last time I tried this I had my heart broken, so I was way more prepared. Crushed it this time around, so stoked to finish the main trip goal so early. Amazing climb with such cool grips and radical movement. Shoutout DWOO bc I'm thinking of him right now. Also Shoutout GUS for being rad, also sending, and driving Kels and I home! Also shoutout Kodi for yet another pre send full tongue sloppy kiss. Also shoutout Kels for climbing so well today and somehow making her way to ALASKA to be with us! Also shoutout Greg for probably being the first frenchman to climb in hatcher. Also shoutout Lisa for being amazing as always and being a trooper!

HARD. like harder than straighten up and fly right. Maybe its that damn raven symbol though. My power reserves are depleted but had to try real hard on this boy. I'm bad at underclings BTW. Muffin Man next time.
Funky.  Used toe hooks on slab.
Starting jugs like this make me melt. Also that backdrop though. I'm a puddle.
This felt like easy slab climbing. Especially compared to the other sit starts on this boulder. Thank god for Greg and his betadine and gauze. Hugely clutch.

Very good climbing with a great view. Hatcher is a magical place. A bit tall but v nice. The sit is surprisingly hard. I don't feel so sticky today though. Me Kels Kodu and Greg exploring monolith today!

Todd Complex ripped most of my right ring finger pad straight off. So much blood. My worst skin injury climbing ever. Again shoutout Greg for actually having first aid stuff. Managed to climb this with my ring finger wrapped in layers and layers of gauze and leuko tape. Basically trying to pull hard while keeping the ring finger lifted. This thing was HARD but i was also down a finger so who knows. Monolith arae has some of the most STELLAR views. Hiking up to this meadow from lower monolith was magical. Worth coming here for the views alone. Amazing highland esque feel with impressive mountain backdrops. Kels and I couldn't quite give Greg the hint. ;).
That's a kinda hard v4 move. But I guess it just seems like it should be hard. Its not actually hard.
WHAT HAVE YOU DONE DERECK!!! NOTHING!!!!!!! NOTHING!!!!!!!!!!
Hi Derek! My name's Little Cletus and I'm here to tell you a few things about child labor laws, ok?
Actually pretty good little rig. Sit start on the obvious big lava holds and move though some other big ones. Once you can stand I'll sign your scorecard. No need to quest the cliff.

I see a BOULDER. it small but I can climbs it! Great fun with Eileen and Kelsey. So basically on the east side of Honolulu bay there are a few reachable beaches. I think the sure break might be here. This is a boulder on one of the beaches. Club the small arete from a squat start on the south side of the block.

North side of the little arete boulder. Start decently low on some interesting pockets.. I think? I actually don't fully remember since I forgot to log and now half a year has past. sigh sigh sigh, But I a grecian god of logging how did I do this

I'm a big Chungus. Land it in my sock sock. Legendary picture. No, not of me. Of Drew, a cupcake and two Ds. Also thanks Scott for posting a picture of Woosifer even though I pulled; sure he looks more beautiful, but I mean, c'mon! Drew talked up my mantling skills, and I severely disappointed the entourage. Luckily Drew saw them later to let them know I did in fact pull.
Nothing like driving 24 hours to show up right in time for my boy to send. I'm so proud of you my son. This is beyond soft, but a nice hello from the forest.

First go, but I tried it a decade ago. Nice to see that I'm actually stronger. Cool climb. Group insanity ramping up, just like drews back pain. I really wonder how many people hate us. RUFIO!!!!!! Hi!!!!

I like the comment about scary topouts... PLURAL. lol. Very cool compression down low into unique top. The second mantle get you real high off the deck, rather scary. Nice climbing with you Davis!! Also IMHO the left hand cross to the pinch is cooler the using the good hold out left.

This is one of those climbs where the 7B grade actually kinda makes sense. A good bit harder than Astroman but maybe not quite enough for V8? What does bump it up to V8 though is friends trying to laugh you off the wall. Nearly got my boy scott with the age old classic "Do you always look like that when you are climbing". lolz. Super soft but a nice spanidonkulus.

Multiple burns jumping for the wrong hold at the top. Running into not one but TWO bishop palls out here. Always a blast with my insane friends. The downclimb tree talk is legitness.. couldn't commit. Yes spanny.
I am stronger than all my of my weak little bitch ass friends.
Cryptic like Pattern and beautiful like Syl. Fun throwing myself at this with the boys figuring out the rexadonkulus moves.

Quite good. Failed on ressy, but get me some better temps and きっと！def want my girl Olivia on the send beats, viterbating to my fail footy and vampire was fire. Probably would have flashed this if the peanut gallery was in support mode, not DGAF mode. Could not find any holds, groping like a 40 year old virgin.
Prime sack spot. Also prime ladder sports spot. Rad pincharoonikus.
The boy being me joy. Thought today might be a rest day, then I thought we were going to Pickle, then Scott got me psycheeeeeed
Beauty. Ideal top out anywhere. Curious if I would have flashed this at Ride the Lightening Height.
Yes, mm-mmm. Sweet jugs to a poorly set top out. Could have been magnificent. Oh well.
Lovely.

Least number of tries for a 10 methinks. Did have to utilize that deep deep try-hard and bust a nut big for the lip. So satisfying and despite how much I hate on Drew and his ridiculous recommendations, this climb was fun. Looks like it might be gross but flows rather well. Time to viterbate boys and girls!
Muahahah sending Scott first what the right choice 👌. His sacrifice was my success. Good job failing my dude to make sure that tick (which we definitely erased) was prime.

Would not have done without Scott leading the charge. And by leading the charge I mean mentioning he wanted to do it then running over to beat him offf…. Er to it. Kinda cool reaching under a root. Kinda not cool. Good thing -1 ain’t under the root am I right?
Nothing like brushing soda water all over the holds. Shout out tan shirt girl and salmon shirt guy. I’m setting a kissing timer!

A missed opportunity Morty. Flash was just one beta away. Good climbing. It’s amazing how much boulders shrank in the last 9 years. Good job Drew at Room Service, glad I could service you. Viterbate away my dude

Most udder ridiculous flailing I’ve enjoyed in a while. Perfect storm of a happy drewbie on silly shit, and funny peeps all around. Had to try really hard to suss fast and send even faster to make sure we made it to Pickle. Send train with Drewbidias!
This will never not be hard. Thanks woo for the beta, thanks Drew for the mamma birded sour gummies YUM!!!
Would not have sent if woo didn’t show up when he did. He really is the yin to my yang, the water to my oil, the lemon to my lime, the    Yes to my no.
I kind always knew I’d flash this. Shout out Jack for being a sacker. Shout out Jamie for the inspiring send, happy to provide ladder downclimb. Once a ladder, always a ladder.

Taking 9 for the tiredness. Rad problem with sweet sweet grippppsssss. You shoulda seen my terrible send adlib beta with a wild cut feet foot stab baby! Charlie is a cute cute girl. Shoutout the boys who ran away, who actually got us an INCREDIBLE plate of sushi. So clutch to come home to that. Love you all. Sleep sweet wittle princes.

What an epic line. Had a really good head space today and just went ahead and dispatched this monster. My clean sweep was so inspiring I got Drew and Preston to try with me and Woo. Great sends all around. Scott I made sure to hold those lock offs extra long for the sweet sweet photos. You better post me and not Woo this time. SO psyched on this one. First say it over a decade ago and never thought id commit, this this boy be changing. Maybe next I'll find love.

Fun crew out here! Finally someone to entertain Drew. lol. Thought I might cruise this but it turned into an epic. Basically one move, but so so frustrating. Woo with the inspiring Choo Choo attempt, but I failed him. With sadness in my heart I was resolved to come back another day, BUT drew and woo played on the that t rex squeeze thing over there  just long enough so I gave it one more burn and that long rest was all I needed.
Meh, Harder than Vigilante for sure.  Pretty hard pull off the ground, then some enjoyable slapparinos and then the  top out wasn't all star.

Sweet block features, this rig is LOOT. Once you get into actual squeezing it softifies. Crazy how many holds you have to grab the wrong way, but somehow that is still rad. Subtle beta changes unlocked it and my rampage of a trip continues!!! So STOKED. Now time for some celebratory wine from our friends at the Salt and Vine. Your friends are hacky sacking in the parking lot. lolol. SCOTT MY SON, YOU WILL SEND IT OMN FRIDAY MORNING MY SON.

More burns than I wanted to give, Friction still felt sub par despite temps finally crispin up a bit. Two pretty rad moves but feels like you start most of the way up the boulder and it's short. Feel the power Kronk. Oh. I can feel it.

Fun date day with Scott. I don't know if he thinks it was a date, But it was, Also doubling padding with a ladder to this boulder was questionable at best. Sweet holds. Enjoyable. Another rest day turned not rest day, Oh well.
Bonus after snagging the test piece. Fun movement!

What a cop out comment Prestige. But he's right. And so was the first ascentionist. This line lives up to the hype and its name. Wish I would have gone for the naked flash, but I foolishly used shoes and flashed anyway. I honestly enjoyed it more the second time sans clothes. Sweet naked train with the boys beating it off to I beat my cock and big chungus. Flipping off was loot too. Now time to drive pinchy to the Airport!! Wish he would have sent but amazing trip all my sons.

Been a while since I had a good ol' m soft first go. The campusing is both silly and rad at the same time. Cool to do once, but any more than that and you are like "now wait a minute!". Grips felt way stickier than the other day when I tried it at swamp o clock. This was probably the highest must do on my list this trip and so so psyched to send. I swear I get stronger on long trips like this and it's sack nasty. Thanks for the Sunny Chibas and the support my dear scotticus. The boys showed up just in time to see the smooth operator resurrect himself.

Wow. Pretty cool. You know its either hard or scary or both if its this cool looking with so few ascents! Some delicate hard crimping to a big ol yeet. The hold you yeet from is worse than you want. Oooh boy. Grip your soul and FIRE!! The rain be coming my dudes and dames. Ran down to ATD to try once the rain started and believe it or not the wetness made it not doable. Seriously 30 seconds earlier and it might have been try enough for a rip lol. This trip was absolutely amazing. Gregor out.
ascents.zlaggableName: Catch a Swollen Heart for not Rollin' Smart

ascents.comment: Final day goblin mode, full goblin in fact. This is up for hardest I tried all trip. Cool drop knee, but at this point in the trip my right hand really didn't feel like it could hold that right hand start hold. Am I too tired? Am I too oozy? Am I a goblin? Amazing trip but ravaged body is ready to go home.
Easier than golden bowl for me, but its funky just like me. A little squeeze here a little slaparoonie there, and a gastadonkula to finish her up.

Wow. Did I really just do this thing!? Thanks for complimenting my RAD shirt Tobey! Woo you were so damn close on the classic David David send train which would have been INSANE. lol. I guess my crimping is seriously improving. Let's stay healthy and see where the wind takes me! Delicate yet powerful, sharp but ergonomic, sopresada. Chase would call me on a day where I sent this thing. Who was chalking up that jump start between the boulders? Totally trying that next time.

Might be okay once cleaned up and all the friable crystals are fried but lets be honest that will never happen bc its not good enough. First mantle is pretty nice. I did a full pistol squat. Second mantle is pretty gropey and desperate! Yarrrrr on whatever crystals you find. Nice job Woo, if only you tried that hard on Buzzsaw! Shoutout Wells, Lindsay and Toby! Nice meeting yalls. Shoutout Matt as well. Oh also shoutout Sweet Chili Doritos. Might be V6 but who knows.
Weather window open! Let's roll Woo! Thing thing is a sweet up-climb, and also a sweet down climb lol. Sorry Tobster that we got to Bang On at such a hot time.

PRNF. Again who is developing this spot!! There are at least 3 AMAZING looking lines on the big boulder that I will be coming back for. This line is a small compression to mantle boy on the first corner of rock when getting to this spot. I saw SEVERAL lines on Fry Keogel that i want to do. I will be back. With Chalk!!!

Came to Woodson, forgot my chalk, decided to scope. I'm always floored when there are still awesome boulders at Woodsen I've never seen or even heard of. This boulder is like a 40 foot lip traverse on a unbelievably thin arete feature. You finish at like 25 feet up which gets quite airy even though its easy. But looking at this feature is crazy, stirs something deep in my rock climbing loins that makes me just want to touch rock. Would be 5 stars but the arete is soo good that you can mantle at any point, making the full line contrived. Also its so thin at some points that even though it sounds and feels solid its scary

PRNF. Was trying to get to the Lighthouse but ended up here. A little spot with some crazy rock quality for woodson. Its like that bullet, patina like dike stuff, not the normal granite. This particular line is amazing jugs and edges. Someone put some effort in to this area, the trail + built landing, I would love to credit the person responsible and give the correct name but for now we shall keep it Secret Secret.
Holds are all good and in nice places. All the meat is in the mantle but its good. Surprised this doesn't get done more. Couldn't pull the send train with Woo on Ubiquitous, next time!

AKA Ubitchwithus. Not that sick but kinda siiiiick you know? Took way more burns than expected, friction not great. Okay movement for an unnamed one star lowball. Was not able to sue the honker sidepull somehow and hand to just downpull the good sloper next to it. If i didn't try this woudl I have sent that guy over there?

Looks like it should be only V7 but packs a bit of a punch. Probably not V10 but it’s fun, very sad I didn’t choo choo with woo woo last weekend. Way harder with worse condies tho, probably a grade easier this weekend. Good times vibing with woo, Dylan and Harper. Just wait till you see my schmecklesz

Trying to make it look easy to psyche up Marina but then I briefly forgot how to control my body. At least Scott had a good little chuckle. Started left hand sloper right hand low opposing thing. Maybe I should have started lower? Cool holds. I want to do that compression thing to the left!

Mr Tiny Man giving this V6 is classic. But to be fair (TO BE FAIR!) he might be closer to the actual grade. Enjoyably moves, creaky first hold, taking points. Good times with good friends. Little Leo signed my scorecard.
Fun! Good work Marina! Don’t love watching people who aren’t good at slab or being up high, not gonna lie. But Marina looked smooth, even with one eye! I’ll bring the beers.

Really should have flashed. Le sigh. Went to the lip a bit faster than intended and just slowly fell off. Mantle went down smooth just like that dinner and Cab Sav from yours truly Mr Yama. Mega soft. Soft second go is my theme for this trip .

This thing is sick. Also most burns of any climb on the boulder. Crux is a cool
delicate move to a jug but that move is just high enough to make you reconsider your life choices! So cool on the shady side. Classic put Marina on her project in the sun lol.
Having a baby made Chase forget what real rock is. Don’t worry you’ll remember sweet boy.
First go. Pretty good climb. Steep with good holds.

First go but flailed on beach ball first. Does seem like maybe the full sit for both of these is the natural start? Good but forced. Shoutout Leo’s dad for taking a nice long nap and letting the Waffle Man herself prove she can still climb post baby and with a “mostly” functional eye ball.
Its in the book and i did it.
Meh, seems too forced. First move was coo and getting up on the scoop was coo but felt forced to stay left. Shade is lovely.

Amazing. Such a cool unique move using that DOPE fin feature. Like I LOVE grabbing holds that make me giddy and that one did. I guess you can mantle early into the subtle dihedral... but that fin called to me and I came. Keeping at 7a only because of how hard Sweet Spot felt.

That is a tough cookie. A real tough cookie indeed. Maybe someone can make this look easy but that was total limit for me... and I'm good at pressing. Beautiful clean face, bullet features and intricate to the max. Yessir that good. Had to crimp really hard for the second move which I didn't love, and to fully stand up at the end I was thumb crimping a micro edge, which I also didn't love. What I'm trying to say is this is hard. Way harder than everything else I did today. Maybe everything else is just super soft. Probably? Leo what do you think? Nice rip at this boulder BTW. That was a king sized fart, doing daddy proud.

I am deeply honored to have been present for Leo’s first outdoor bouldering outing 🥰. The portable play area thing is prime. My favorite part of today was watching Chase struggle carrying pads. To be fair (TO BE FAIR!), he packed them wrong with heavy on the outside. Scrub. This is best on boulder fer sher. Tahoe is purdy

P-cool. Its amazing how hard it is to climb when you feel like people are waiting, even if you know they aren't and what they want most is you to succeed. I get that feeling all the time. Maybe that's why I don't project and why I climb alone so much.  Waffleman good perseverance, seeing you up this thing was a highlight of the day. You still steeeeooong. Enjoyable wild swing on my flashkeypoo.

This thing is rad. Like the iron man of crimping, only better and finishing up instead of sideways. Only downside is how much harder it is if you are not tall. That line of crimps with a gorgeous foot rail is quite ludicrous. Good sweep Scott and Chase! I think we all had to turn on some deep try hard. I loved climbing with all you. Thanks Chase Scott Marina and Leo for a lovely short trip to Tahoe.

OH also Will Ally and Owen!! Love all yalls.
First go. Points. P fun.

Mega softie. Unless you ask Chase on his repeat attempt rampage. I low key love hearing how much he complains about his skin being bad lately. Lol. Let the soft second go continue. Bottom was cheese, fell on arguable the easiest move on the climb. Just thought I was on a jug but I had actually grabbed air.
You think wet skin is your ally? You merely adopted wet skin. I was born in it, molded by it. I didn't see the dry skin until I was already a man, by then it was nothing to me but aid!
oooh spicy mamma. Cant wait to fall on this from the sit!
That top jug is orgasmic after all them crimps. Crux techy foot move for the come in, but besides that is a crimp machine my dudes and dames. Magic last goes.
Enjoyable. Crux is literally a foot switch which was unexpected. Seems a bit forced when House of Pain is the direct line, but glad I did it.

Seemed worth doing and it was. Ill climb anything tho. A quickie if you will. I love accidentally yelling when babies are sleeping. Oh my. Sorry Marina and little Leo. Honestly don't remember the climb already... i thnk maybe thej first move was sweet

Overall this is real real good. Beautiful measure of wall outlined by two perfect bars of trees.  The jug pinch start feature is ludicrously big and o so nice.  Scott almost did in his cruisies but well he didnt. Tree Aids he has. I did in my "shout out rick" shoes AKA those north face down booties.
Actually pretty good. Warmin gup in my cruisers and got scurred. Then I saw scott get scurred in this real shoes and decided it looked soft. Ran up it in my cruisers thereafter
I did a full sit start which felt a bit harder. Three boys a baby and marina. That's the story for the day. Everybody loves uncle scott.
another one I done did.

Agreed. Surprisingly fun. As per my previous comment on "Rocket from the tomb" I was having a bit of an out of body experience and this felt hard. Like tons of concentration to make my body do normal things, to have an iota of control. Anyway I loved that this is steep, but still manages to have a bit of a dihedral feel. My beta was big (slightly uncomfortable) gaston lock off then fliparino into a very comforable undercling to bump right hand. Lookign back it seems easy, but it sure took some gusto in my condition.

Honestly this thing is pretty rad. Full on horizontal with some serious tension. A bit spanny indeed but nothing we can do bout that. Felt impossible a decade ago with Fong, so pretty dope for it to feel pretty doable today with Kels. Thanks Kels for taking me up here in Nora =D. It was quite a treat to actually sleep in a van instead of dribing home crazy late like i normally do. Glad you finally got to see black and glad you had a good time! Nice work on NRA, Adamantium will go next time!!

I did not really enjoy my time here. I tried it years ago and got scarred. This time I realized you can just span from jug to jug.... it does have aesthetic height... but thats bout it.  Shortly after sending I got mad blurry eyes.. like real bad. I though maybe someone drugged me. I felt like the wooziness and blurriness when super wasted but without the rest of the wasted feelings. I thought maybe it was the start of a Migrane? I also started thinking about Waffleman and her eye problems since the fuzziness was debilitating. It slowly went away, and Kels gave me ahead massage but it was wonk. I tried climbing afterward and didn't feel like I was 100% in control of my body. Like there was a bit of a lag and a lack of power throughput. I hope this was a one time thing.

Fun. Boulders are even harder to grade these days. Like even in the quadrent how do you rank Champagne, Morning Again, Choss Boss and This? Like Champagne might be the accepted hardest but that was by far the easiest for me and did it years ago. Choss Boss took me way more burns than Morning again or this but its definitely easier. Classic Chris Chen might be right and everything on the mountain is V8 just different styles. If i were to rank these in order of easy to hard it would be:  Champagne, Choss Boss, Scarpetta, Morning Again. But I'm giving this 9 anyway. The grades are made up and the points don't matter.

Very cool face with cool bullet holds. I did not think it was V5 but I just finished ranting about not knowing grades anymore sooooo who knows. My tippos are absolutely gone. Hungry Hungry tippos. Everythign hurts. I was thin from Tahoe and now im obliterated.

I really liked this one. Especially with the high and low options. Both climb super well. Shoutout Kels for the most amazing pre-surgery thank you in Little Tokyo. One of the best sushi experiences ever.  I really enjoyed the whole trip. Now heal up!! Happy no more tonsils!!!

I decided to go super modest with this name. I wanted something epic, but still held a connection to me. I want my grandkids to see this in a book, on in a yo tube video and be struck with respect and awe by name alone. I want this name to garner that power. This is the best FA I have ever done and I want to scream to the world that I did this. Me, the one and only  Gregor Recian-God has done this. Magical session with Woo, our top rope was... sick even if it was unfuctional. Cool holds, good intricate and nuanced movement, inspiring height and gorgeous aesthetics. Im so curious if people end up using the flip-a-dee-doo-dah beta. This rig has it all. Wow. Such a beautiful face, even if the dick is small. Also... where the fuck is Marcus!?
Felt hard. Start move is cool but then it seemed uninspired. Too crimpy for what I want right now.
The more natural exit. Nice holds. Actually all the holds today felt wonderful. The cool Tahoe rock is tickling my ickaling.
I did not flash I did not. Less than 2 hours of boulder time today so this is my warm up!
its k. You might also do it when you are rampaging the boulder for pointssssss and skin prep. What a great boulder for some quick quantity.
P cool. Blue the dog is stoked.
A bouldering day with mommy!!! How lovely. A nice area for some quick volume! Cool obvious line.

Handful of goes with some friends and a dog named blue. Just needed to find the right foot. I like Tahoe everyone. It's nice here. I want to eat more boulders nom nom nom, Also love the Goonies reference. Hey you guysssss!!!!

I personally didn't like the opening sequence., I ended up double gastoning, before entering the squeeze moves. Me likey. Took much brain power to figure out the crux. I couldn't believe after hitting the big left hand edge I couldn't find an easy top. Finally I got my left foot up and the sequence was unlocked. Once unlocked it was unlocked. Thanks Scott for the quick recs on short notice. Fun sending with Patty Jo Vasko, the angle herself.

That was cool. Butchered beta on first goes but that's some good fun. Seriously all these holds feel so so good, I'm getting stoked. Well I'm always stoked on climbing but now I'm giddy. Thanks mom for the encouraging spotting words.
Anything that starts on a jug like that is good in my book. Also features all the way are quite rad. Thanks mom for helping me quickly move pads as I rampage this boulder!

ooooh this was hard for me. I think it's bc I was trying not to rest between climbs. When I finally found feet it felt good, but before that it felt real not good. Cool moves. I like the move to the lip.

Goddam the dreaded second GO. Only took 3.5 minute rest before dispatching so obviously me not flashing was a fluke. Actually said "damnit" when topping out which was out of character. Sick of this not flashing bull shit. The ambiance at this bounder is amazing. Such a gorgeous backdrop. I would do this without pads, i think im on a highball kick. Shoutout my parent for joining me at Pie Shop!! My dad made it all the way to Diamonds are forever which was too hard for me so I'm sure my dad thinks, "Wow my son cant even climb even though he's devoted 15 years. What a waste". JK he loves me. It was a great week spending quality time with my parents. Also saw Jeses Bonin apparently here which was sick. I asked him if he was going to try "Diamonds" with me and he was like "oh i already did that. I FAed it" lol. Also shoutout friendsgiving. Sorry Scott for saying unthinking things. Sometimes I'm fucked up. Lynn those customized cookies were sick. Oh also fuck the sun, salt in the wounds for the second go. Perfect lighting for teh fail go then sun blinded washed out garbage for the send Classic.

Yeah this is way harder than Pepsi Challenge sit. Also feels contrived to cut right into a supposed  V5 which is actually harder that Pepsi Challenge. I'm stoked to log this bc I met Jesse at Diamonds are Forever and now we are Log Pals!! High five my dude!

Great climb. Was sitting here with Scott who was like "'People' downgrade High Priority?" then I saw his log which was a downgrade to 7A+ soft. lolol. Yeah definitely soft but I'm taking the points for that hike. I assumed we would be roadside today, since I was planning on getting back to a Japanese lesson at 5pm. Parked at 12:15 and looked up the GPS coordinate and saw that it was 3.5 miles away. Wow. Bushwacked the last bit but found my crew and sick times were had. Just hopped right on this and whipped her out cold turkey. Powerful and real real fun.
This was way harder than Pepsi challenge. Thanks Jenny for leading the charge and just doing the beta we thought all along. God that’s a hard foot move.
Luckily I fell on the sit before touching the stand holds so i could still eek out a flash on the stand. Good climbing.
I think I would have flashed if someone told me to just go big to the good holds and not squeeze myself into that small double heel under cling box. Good climb.

Agreed. This climb is an endurance monster. Barely held it together for the cruxy final moves. Stoked to get on my first Chaad Haarmed FA. All jokes aside the intentional right hand cut when gunning for the big move feet pincer gets a start all on its own.

Good finale. Now time to go run back to my car so I can make it yo our Succulent Chinese meal with my parents. Thanks again for a amazing week mom and dad. Glad I only brought one pad and a ladder instead of a double pad with ladder.

Wow. Agree to all the comments. Does not look like it should be that hard but damn those feet get frustrating. Also frustrated by catching that last good slot hold before the big move. My sausages just wouldnt slide into that slot. Jenny with the almost flash big fall off the sloper jug was awesome. magnifico! Alwasy happy to touch a butt for safety. Nice sends Scott and Jenny! Im definitely not making my Japanese class at this point lolol. Also gonna be late for dinner with parents.

First go but tried it back in 2018. Amazing group psych with Ned, Pinch, Scott and my real boy Woo. Amazing line as you all know. So good to have the boys back together. Thanks Lynn for letting me stayyyyy. Also Kelsey I can’t wait to see your cute little Grayvie 😻. Good falls Ned, I got your ass!
woo woo Choo Choo

Apparently I did an eliminate. Skip the Gaston and just bust al the way from the jug to the sweet-as crimp. Jasper did it they says, I've done it they say, its easy they say. Liars. Or just people with bad memory. What I did felt harder than Sierra Pinstripes.

What a lovely day for a hike and a magical Choo Choo with my boys. Scott leading the charge, me forming the link, and woo putting up a mean caboose. I did the top to show Scott how soft it was then somehow pulled on my first bot rip. Means it must be soft. Yes I said those words Wooseph.
Book has V5 but I could see either. I climbed this very very bad. Cool features.

I'm an addict. Addicted to rock. God help me. This climb is to the left of Dave's Roof on the small barrel like roof toward the right side. Start with left hand on a bad but slightly incut crimp and right hand on a friction sloper with an obvious thumb catch. Throw a toe cam in at the split, pull on then slap to the lip! From there it's an enjoyable ~V3 mantle. So this climb is a single one foot right hand move. It's going to be crazy morpho, drew wouldn't have to cut when hitting the lip and will probably call it V5. But hey It felt harder than Tequila Sunset to me and I'm rewarding myself for climbing like a savage this trip. I don't actually want an intervention, I like this addiction. Note - the low might go and it would be really really hard.
Fifth day on is well, rough. How is my skin even still holding? Real MVP goes to skin. Gooldlittle squeeze. Woo is the king of conservation lol.

Impressive flash my son. I really didn't like that drop knee at the end, I ended up staying open. Wish I knew my beta earlier bc every burn felt harder. Glad I had the hutzpah (and the reminder from woo to bump my left lol), to pull. This means I have 5 days sending V8+. Woot woot! That's a sick streak. Sicker than a Duo Streak that's for sure. All of those days had V9 except the White lines day. I am a grecian god of shittiness and modesty. This climb is beautiful, great condies today.
nice little pit stop. Those slopers are sweet grips. Scott you are on a sour patch ban. Never forget the hackey sack again.

Unnamed in the book. Tried to do it once thinking some holds were off and did it the second time. Testing my skin. Believe it or not my puncture on mr right middle somehow healed over the past two days of climbing lol. How do I still have skin? Why am I climbing unnamed climbs? Good questions.

Today's condies were the closest this will ever be to V8. Glad everyone agrees to be whores together. When I finally had a sequence it actually felt okay. Fell once after latching the good hold which was hilarious, but no where near as hilarious as Woos Shutts punt lol. We both sent subsequent burn tho. Starting pinch is sweet as
Wow we actually woo woo Choo Chooed woo woo Choo choos!!!! Temps made that sloper a jugtastic voyage. Still needed the fan tho.

I hate underclings. My original beta didn't use any of the holds (even as feet) out left, but I might be a bit le tired, so I decided to fully flaccidify the rig. It's hard to properly rest when it's so cold. You sit for 2 seconds and you are shivering. Fuck it im ready to burnski. Took more burns that Shutts or Greenpeace sooooooooooo I hate underclings.

Wow we actually Woo Woo Choo Choo ed. We been off the tracks a bit lately so pretty sweet to lay it down. Wonderful cold temps, but still need the fan. Always bring the fan. These fingies of mine.  Sweet moves on sweet rock. The two finger crimp is a bit rough, but it's all part of it. Nice to climb this today as a goodbye to the man himself. Already miss ya. ALSO this area is loaded with sweet projects. The big arete to the left or ride the lightning for sure goes. Woo let's rope it. Oh also the slab to the right of Rider the lightening! OHHH and the yeetiest of them all the "Yeet Yourself" project on top of the slab to the right of ride the lighting. Did all the moves but daaaaamn the worst case potential is death. The low looks like 12 or harder.  Think about the name potential "Vasqueezious"? "Woocifers Squeeze"? Its endless.

Whoa. m Soft first go. It’s stickiest on the first go which is why it felt soft I’m sure. Today was crazy. Met woo and Christine at the freeway and met Christine. Yes I think that English works. It was very nice to meet you ☺️. Anyway, not a could in the sky, this is 11am. As we drive up we start to see some beautiful whispies over Marion mountain. When we get to the basin it feels p-nice. Good to hug Kevin after all these months and see his ladder and killer Dremel. Also good to see Aden and Greg!! Snagged a hug at the freeway then also at I Animal. Anyway my goal today was to try Sans but well remember that cloudless sky? It didn’t stay cloudless. After I animal the clouds decide to just go full wet and end the climbing day early. Nice dub dub woo. Also saw some Mesa Rim peeps and tried to give them bad directions to the decembers and forgot to ask their names 🤦‍♂️.

Thought I might get my fist Bishop goose egg. Sorry to disappoint Kels and Kevin. First move felt really hard but I realized later I was doing it much differently than in the past. I used a large drop knee to reach out straight to the good opposing hold you toe hook from.  It did lower Shirley's move count down from 12 to like 9 though which was neat. Top out feels ways easier than it did when I sent Cindy, and I actually used the traditional beta. Teed up on Sharma Traverse and Finders Fee, would also be keen on Finding Cindy's Top. Fun hiking loop today! Birthday parking > Steep Sharma Traverse > Pollen Grains > Road back to Birthday Parking. Would do again. The terrain between Sharma Traverse and Pollen Grains is RAD! Some fun frozen wittle water falls, and some tall rocks. Shoutout Kels for clutch lodgings and Woo + Kevin for good times. Gojira was mmmmm.

The real Rio's Secret Arete!! Actually pretty fun despite climbing out of a dab hole (You don't actually dab!). Rad grips, especially that fin. One of those cases where avoiding the dab forces some fun control via a sweet toe hook. Located on the boulder immediately east of Rio's Secret Arete boulder, south face in a rodent hole.

I really, REALLY, wanted this one. So elated to finally stick that V5 crux on Wills Arete: I didn't scream externally but I did internally and it was a massive orgasm. Too many people around to let that shit out but I may have totally jizzed myself. It's been a fun journey working this over the years and honestly a bit sad to end this story.  I hope this doesn't mean I'm a rope climber now. Gunning for all the obnoxious traverses and the only one left really is Super Froz! Also shoutout fun session on Atari, good work Kevin, so many pads.

Re-Logging bc I doubt I did it from the sit in the past. Maybe I did but who cares bc I deserve a secondary log for doing it in my cruisers just to show Kevin up. Mandatory one arm swing on the lip for style. Real enjoyable funky moves on this striking arete: a push, a pull, a foot in your ass, a revolution! Awesome job on the Send Kels!! Super fun weekend, wish we could have ended the trip on a team send.... but oh well poor Kevin's Box getting brutalized this weekend lol. Kelsey, thanks so much again for being an incredible host to me and Kevin!

Pretty fun Hueco-esc face. Snaked the FA from woo which was rad. I also forced the OFFICIAL start to be lower than it probably should bc I had that power. Start with a thin but deep slot for your left hand that my sausages barely fit inside, and a okay opposing right edge. The low foot is good and rad. Move left hand into what realistically should be the start hold, but I say no. Harder than it looks, and kinda sharp. Also located on the boulder to the east of Rio's Secret Arete, south face, left side, near another dang it hole that climbed Kelsey sock not once... but TWICE. New age classic. Also would be surprised if I actually FAed this.

I'd seen this in the book before but never really actually "SEEN" the line before. But with my trusty ladder and massive deduction skills I was able to ascertain the route. Quite fun with some sweet grips and actually not too hard. Definitely distinct from Groteque or Witty. Good work Kevin not kicking that dudes head as he was falling. The Simulclimb was hilarious.

It's wild that world class lines like this only have 4 ascents on 8a. A butt plug like that doesn't come around every dynasty. Some slab, some barn door arete action, a dyno, some good overhang edges and some light highball spice?! Really doesn't get better. So rad running into Ice and Themo after all these years. Also wild that we both independently decided to try this thing today (and both sent!). Sans next time!! I just need more patience >.< Kevins box is hilarious. His beta does throw a toe hook into the mix though which might make it even better.

Oh heck yeah Kevin!!! Color me entertained 💉 🪨. Nice Kevin Gregor Choo Choo. A bit short, a bit sharp and maybe a bit friable but hey! That was a fun 2.5 moves. I started cleaning this because the starting crimps were SO obvious and nice feeling with obvious feet. Some friable flakes had to go but the remaining crimp makes for an entertaining line. Keep up that days climbed metric Kevin!  Juggos on the top are sweet as.

first go but already did flying festoon and das atrium so not really. Oh and I isolated the top so  actually first go from the bottom is more apt. Remember looking at this years ago and wondering why this was even in the book. Way too scary. Speaking of butt plugs, I plugged up the chasm a bit with some tree bits which made the landing actually pretty good. Cool movement to turn the corner onto the face, than real sweet pods up to the high crux. High crux looked intimidating, but I found beta that made it pretty secure and kept me within Kevin's reach for a "pull" spot. Not that scary honestly sweet climbing all the way through.

I just emotionally short circuited. This climb is all time and this feeling is indescribable. Disbelief, excitement, fear, anxiety, relief, euphoric joy. Glad the epic is over, but glad I stubbornly chose this for my first V11. The flood gates are now open!! Thanks to all my support. Stoked to finally tell Drew I sent it after he Finds My ass and asks if I’m tying it today. Thanks Ice, I needed you to send today… At the very least to remind me to turn on my head torch lol. My world is a bit shattered right now and I don’t really know what my purpose is anymore. Maybe Fight Club? lol. Soak in the bliss. Shoutout black and metallic green nails. Apparently all my V11 are with painted nails now. I regret not bringing the champagne, but at least I had a pure project waiting for me at the top. 2024 was a banger. Best boulder on the mountain? Best boulder in SoCal?
A decently fun move actually. Fun end of the day with the crew, and trowing myself at sub par boulders with woo.

Wow what the heck!! Another example where names are CRITICAL ladies and gentleman. I have NEVER looked at this boulder in the past bc it was called Unnamed Crack.... I just downloaded Kaya and saw this as "Classic Seam" and was bewildered. When I scoped it I was blown away by a literally perfect thin crack. Sharp, but so doable and gorgeous. The OG I guess is a stand start at about head height. Thanks again Kody for giving this Rock a name, the rock gods are happy with you. this is indeed CLASSIC. Try iy my dudes and dames.

The natural start to this line, equally good but SO much more painful. I'm sure difficulty changes a lot depending on finger size, but really cool movement. It was too painful and I had given up, but then Noah taught us about pre-tape. That beta was key, with some tape on the tippos I was finally able to yar hard enough. The sit crux is sweet powerful foot tension move, which brings you into the rad top.

Thought I might try Dark Horse with Tobster but nah, let's get back to our roots and do all the things, who cares about stars or difficulty! Im free from the shackles of my project!!! I couldn't even do false dark horse, these poor fingers!

Looked kinda stupid but it actually climbed nice. Sweet as pinch and enjoyable mantle. Thanks Kody for trying to remove some of the "Unnamed" things here. Im serious when I say OK Knob is so so so so. much better than Unnamed Arete.

Rather fun, especially  for how little traffic it gets! A lot of really nice holds, but definitely a bit tricky. Took me almost 10 tries! I'll split the difference and say V4. Nice camaraderie being silly with Woo and Noah on Mens #1 lol.

Damn. High quality shit visible from the road is still undone!?!? Really? I feel like Socal Royalty himself over here, I got that VISION. After I tarped sans I ran back to the parking and scoped boulders while I waited for Ice and found THIS rig! Pretty darn sweet with a bit of height spice.
