Though start leads to enjoyable balancy arete climbing higher. So glad your finger is feeling good woo!!! Glad you snaked. The starting crimp kept crumbling but I think maybe this iteration is finally solid. First right hand crimp is quite sharp. Location about 100 yards east of Squozimoto. 200 yards south of 1st Boulder. it's a nice arete visible from the road... try it!!

Ok..... NEXT time we will let you on board the Woo Woo Choo Choo. I promise. Speaking of Men Oxes, I was a man ox today building the landing for the "Apollo Wept" project. Yep that's what im calling it, the tall gorgeous face behind Sans. I did some insanely sketchy stuff building that landing but I am a Man Ox myself. I also felt like a highlander, carrying logs that are way too large. Im ready for the Highland Games, Really should have filmed the building of the landing. It was epic. I am so scratched up. ALLLLSSSSOOO pretty sure the landing is why I was too tired for Big Game. I am so wrecked today (the day after) . Anyway, Man Ox is p-cool. lots of enjoyable moves and a cool crux from a big foot.
derp a derp. Funny little lurch. Climb all the things!

The David-David bond is too strong! It's resisting the addition of Ice to our Choo Choo! Im sorry my duddeeee! Three way train next time for sure, gotta start brainstorming 3-way names; woo-woo-choo-choo is the gold standard. This climb is rad, kind of hard to read, but it's good! Top out is wonderful, a bit of spice but it's all there. Not too scary with good spotters. I hope the Spren of this rock is happy to have been gang banged after all these years in obscurity

If I hadn't just done The Statue of David this would undoubtedly be my best FA ever. Now I honestly don't know, both climbs are INCREDIBLE. This things is 30 vertical feet of awesome. I know any climber who frequents deep corral has looked at this face and wondered if it goes. It fucking does. It really fucking does. And it slaps. I spend like 2-3 hours last weekend building the landing, and I brought a rope today to clean and rehearse. Bottom had a fair amount of choss to polish off, and a few loose holds, but as you go up the rock quality just gets better and better. After cleaning there were holds everywhere you need them. A lower power crux and a delicate finish make this thing a movement masterpiece. Starts on a jugtastic block and finishes through the prominent xeno just like my original VISION. First go sans rope and I climbed it like I was Apollo himself. Im a Grecian God of Modesty so get on my FAs, they are INCREDIBLE. The way I did the top crux is reachy, Ice did find another hold which eases some of the span, but that is the only detractor from perfection. While you climb ~30ft the landing is ~10ft off the ground. This boulder is moosive. 2025 is already a banger!

I thought this was soft... I really did... until it turned into an epic. I stuck the foot up move probably 10 times from the bottom before I decided I needed new beta to stick the move to the jug. It's a jug though... why couldn't I hold it! Crazy interesting movement on this one and quite aesthetic once it's painted up with chalk. Was riding hight from "Apollo Wept" and expected to cruise this and DG then go grab a celebratory Pinot Noir, but 4 hours later and there is no more time time for wine and I think no more DG. You grab that one hold in an all kinds of fucked up way, then grab that grainy bulge like it's actually a hold (hopefully those grains are adamantium and never break... will be harder if even one grain says so long). Looks like it should be way harder than it is, but once you unlock the cryptic sequence it really isn't that bad. Had to do shirtless to show off my mawscles in the vid. For how good this is it needs more traffic. The legendary 4 start recommend inbound

Thought it would be cooler. The novelty of starting off the bush lost its magic after the first couple goes. I massively cleaned the top for safety.... so much moss. Still lots but less. Once I found beta that worked it felt quite doable and might even bee good, but the overall experience on this was less than my expectations. Beta was rather unintuitive, so solving the equation was enjoyable. I did top out at perfect sunset time so that was nice. Oh I finally did the 180 jump off the lions mane bc I didn't want to down climb which was softer than I expected.

Did the jump in iso in cruisers from the big left facing feature and the obvious right hand pod crimp, then had a nightmare of a time linking from the easy beginning... like what? Did it as a dyno from low holds, as a big move from a slightly higher left hand, and as a right had move from a cool right heel. Meh. Good reps.

Lovely first climb to put Magz on! Didn't bag but great progress and great seeing her on the rocks. Nice to meet loads of people here INCLUDING people who went to the same Hayley Heynderickx concert. Didn't see yalls there but it was a pleasure Keving and Emay.
This makes a nice wombo with its partner in crime.
What knee bar? I mean the starting one is obvious but I thought the left side of the high Hueco was off. Maybe it's just off for hands? What I did felt super hard.
Better than it looked. Would not have tried without the rec from our friends with the cute dog named Moose who looks like a panda.
What smith did. Honestly my favorite variation on the boulder after false Hueco and false Hueco traverse. had some cool toe hooks and heels at golden hour.
dabba yabba straight did. Waited just long enough till the sea of pads was pulled and had to do it Han Solo. cool xeno

This was close with stars so we tried it. As per ushe hard for V0. Mags made som good moves tho and even took a few falls. Way to go hard! Push through the blood and pain lol. Almost cool, but do a basically downward move right to get into the better holds.

I probably did this thing at some point but I can't remember. This was Magz first ever outdoor boulder which is a pretty sick. You were impressive on this. Clean and confident! Lets get you on more rocks!
Honestly not as good as Dragon Scales. Seems like why aren't I on that thing over there. I would have swapped the stars IMHO.
So freaking amazing, just like our Saturday afternoon near Rail Shark!

Logging the mantle variation for the top out of Liquid Courage bc it was sick. Start on slopers and off route any of the hands out left, namely the ear. Throw left heel up, fliparino that wrist to get it on the little rise and do a true press. Also great work Richie and Sierra on Liquid Courage. What a great addition. Ill remember to bring tequila next time.
Surprisingly fun! shoutout Misty. Both your Pokemon crush and the beautiful doggo. Sorry about doggy jail. Good find this one.

Good fun! Is the cheat stone on for the start? Who knows and who cares. Use it and have a grand time. Another one with surprising amount of fun for a V0. Mags totally could have gotten this if it wasn't end of trip. Amazing first overnight trip with you!!!

Fun triple point match in the corridor between Misty Mountain and Liquid Courage. I'll be back to try liquid courage again and might put some effort into landing building. Shoutout Ryan for his vision. Also Happy Birthday Sierra! Thanks for letting me and Mags swing by for a bit!
Wow that was fun. Hard to make an interesting ~V1 and this did it.
Crawling into this crack was worth it. The climb was maybe worth it. But I enjoyed myself. But I always enjoy myself so that's not saying much.
Fun link definitely worth doing. If it was the only way up the boulder it would be stellar but since you trav it's only so so.

A wonderful climb. Truly wonderful. I can't wait to see what Waffleman says. You truly are a man amongst me... errr we'll maybe a women amongst women? Hmm maybe just a person amongst people. yeah that's good. Shout you out for proving giving birth doesn't have to make you weak. Heal quick, much love <3

Actually kinda sick. Fun boulder to ladder up and explore. Real fun to actually work with Scott and Girth. Whose stronger? Whose weaker? No one knows but it was a smashing good time. Twin cracks was dripping so I leaf blew the top for the community. We did a stand start, can def stir start but shrug. Book implied high stat. Nebulous at first but once chalked up it makes more and more sense. After I sent Scott found an opposite g hold which made it easier (and better looking). Worth doing and more than 1 star IMO. I love my truck, I love my friends. So great to finally meet you Carina.

Hard in such a different way than Flecheros. Wow. Also I said no film but I wish we did. I did a comp style 180 campus. It was a desperation campus not a style campus. I doubt this climb has ever been done this way. Wow. I’m insane. But that was sweet. Good fun good camaraderie I love rocks
Hard first move then eases up into a really really nice slab problem. Fun wanking it with Woo and Dylan out here.

It's like the big greeny of the republic! Honestly really good and worth doing. Even better now with the annoying tree to your left gone. You can actually press start into the perfect friction slab above. Easy and fun and im gunning for 3000 climbs before Aden!
I did the toe hook start variation today. lolol. Real stupid real fun. For full enjoyment I made sure to full pendulum it just to show I could. Same grade as og.

Jump starts have a special place in my heart. lol. The book here is hilarious. It actually tells you to start with your left hand on the fallen tree... but time must have moved the tree since that makes like no sense. I did it bc the book said it but it's like out of the way. Cool features you jump too so I understand, but I think this climb feels worse bc you wish the overhang into this was climbable. Top was non trivial. Stoked to come back for moss project!
I wish I had those edgeless shoes Dylan! Nice.

Woo going heavy with the inspiration. I'll follow that booty anywhere. Blew the Woo Woo Choo Choo but caught a ride on the next train over. Awesome day boys. Glad I bought a truck so I can park it on the freeway and walk all the way here. I also topped out early which makes it more soft, but it's just more obvious.

Such an obvious line. And it's great that this long line kept with the "Squamish" lip traverse theme. Definitely easy, and you could rock over anywhere, and "when" you are supposed to rock over is a bit dubious (I was at the log), but its good climbing, and just an overall good time. No pressure my dudes and dames!

This thing is QUITE good. Especially since that asshole David Vasko cleared the remnants of that dead tree away. Like the aesthetics of this line just went WAY up. And no more annoying "am I dabbing? a, I not dabbing?". I remember trying this years ago at the recommendation of Kody. Definitely worth doing. Pretty piece of rock with enjoyable moves! Definitely needs some coolish temps. Woo somehow broke a sloper with his fat ass. It was hilarious. Woo WoOooOO CHooOOO ChooOOoo.
Class 4? Not sure if this needed to be a climb,. Oh don't get me wrong it this was MK I would have FA'ed it too.

Meh. It's a climb with some features. It almost climbs good but just seems like a bit of a letdown. Finally weighed my bouldering rig and my pack is over 100 pounds. This approach is 2 miles. I am a Grecian God.
Slightly better than what Zarathustra said even thought its by definition contrived. The mantle was just more fun.
Another meh. Must beat Aden to 3000! At least the features are rather obvious but the climbing is a bit uninspired. Props on the FA name tho. Sweet.

Nice name. Chad and I started on the jumbo juggo lower left which added a powerful first move. Another dec warm uppo. Left SD at 6pm drove until 2 am slept in till 5 am then finished the drive and pretty much instantly left for the boulders. My body is so close to systemic failure but Im a grecian god so that shit is soft. I crossed a timezone and there was daylight savings so I don't even know how long that drive or sleep were.
AKA kung fu theater warm up #1. Furthest right line. Some good crimpos but damn you get spoiled on granite. I have to remember what sandstone feels like. Im afraid im going to break everything.

Cool holds, much nice. Perfect lip bucket to make a good mantle, and of course I slurped that shit up. Jug was invisible from below lol. Scot double padded with a rope up here, I double padded with a ladder, It was absolutely the right call, but that hike down was rough... psyche got us up there.. lack of sleep lack of food, and goddamn mud made a real slog down. We are athletes.  Ive climbed so much high stuff lately that this felt inches off the ground. Ill get under your butt anytime Chad.

Scott you just HAD to derail the send train with that pitiful attempt. Nothing like climbing with your boy to get yourself FULLY TORKED!!! Yeah I think we found easier and in my professional and 100% always objectively correct opinion, better beta. It skips the fucked up pull through we all saw Mr Fultz do in the only video of this. Instead you end up reaching up and right to the smile crimp first which makes the move to the above the lip pod way easier. My top out beta also made that move cake. Awesome climb nonetheless. only detractor is the unpureness. So hot.

Im insanely good at mantling but damn. After looking at the FA video I realized I mantled direct, going straight up from the jugs. I saw the option to go left into the top of Master Splinter but from the line on Kaya it looked like this was supposed to be direct. Probably harder than Kung Fu Theater this way, and maybe even harder than Zatoichi. So might even be V8 this way. It's crazy when one bloc has so many goodies. Why doesn't 8a.nu have a flag for "mantly".

AMAZING start hold. Love that for this climb. Top is a bit unintuitive with a bunch of broken looking or friable edges. Wish it climbed a bit more direct but oh well. This side of the boulder is just a sweet warm up for the main attractions. Im getting so close to 3000 logs on 8a!!!

Yeah dis one is dope. The one problem with a wall like KFT is that there are so many lines and so many holds that you really start wondering WHAT is even on. The way I did this didn't use any of the features on Kung Fury, which made the crux sequence a hard jump from the pocket jug all the way to the right facing feature followed by a hard come in move. Certainly harder my way. Also I realized that the original video used the giant friable looking foot (crux hold on Grand Master). No way would I want to use that shit that high off the deck. Scott and I just smeared and that was sufficient to slap up to the better holds around the lip. I also realized is tarted slightly higher than the FA. oops. might never make it up here again so I guess... good enough for government work.
Days climbed metric baby. Super good climb.

I wanted to prove that Dungeon Master was contrived. Start as for Dungeon Master and go straight up. Landing is not great and hold quality is even worse. But my dudes and dames, it's got some cool moves! A rad start crux pulling through a sloper leads to an insanely delicate "please don't break please don't break please don't break" Top! I trended right after the first move toward Dungeon master and topped out just to the right of the little tree growing in the rock. Found a sweet press move for the top which is certainly not needed but was enjoyable. Oh glad I got the video of me tapping that "plate" which shattered into one million pieces with a small tap. Sorry for scaring ya Scott

For how big the holds are I don't know how this is even remotely hard. But it is. Post break my dudes and dames!! It still goes, and it's arguable better. As more and more of the horrible choss rips of it will continue to get harder and better! Oh only the top is choss, bottom is fudging sweet. Giving it the upgrade bc post break, but honestly more because I want to reward myself with vacation and hiking points. After downgrading Kung Fury  I really needed som points. I mean it felt harder than Kung Fury soooo. Can't believe I got Scott to come bask up here again after swearing he would never come to Kung FU Theather again. Im proud of you. Well make a grecian got out of you yet. Oh this line is kinda contrived, could jag up/left early for sure. I tried hard to not use the left jug on the top out to stick it to the man but I got tired and used it... Probably like 9.6 ish. Another Choo Choo blew by Chad
Sweet. Awesome session with the hooligans Carina and Chad. Scott and I scored and awesome engagement photo of us. He looks at me so longingly <3

My beta on this was thoroughly insane. And that made it real fun. A toe hook and a heel toe cam at the same time. I knew it would go other ways but once I found that insanity I had to use it. Had a true punt where my right foot sanded off on the last move to the top out jug. You don't get those unexpected falls that ofter!

suddenly the Coal Mind boulder is STACKED. 11, 10, 10, 10, 9, 8, 8, 7, 7 . If you stage clear that would be like 80 V points on a SINGLE boulder. This was fun. Has a bit of awk but cool grips and uniqueish climbing
So good! Was looking for quality 2s for Magzag and this boy came up. Enjoyable moves the whole way with nice holds. Will repeat every time im in this area! Gotta catch em all!
I did not enjoy this much as "The Coal rail".
I got caught by the tarp police yesterday. Big sad. The leaf blower is clutch. Kept this boulder dry at least. Good climb. Great to see Munin making good moves despite the debilitating cold!
Cool block hold okay top. Tis cold today.
It's a climb. Nice excuse to start on them jugs again, Never actually warmed up on the warm up boulder
Actually reeky good! The one fixable hold up high is not ideal but we can work with that.

I kinda thought I might never actually do this one, but I finally found a way to sneak my big sausages into that slot. Ended up with an above my hands heel hook, followed by a Spock pseudo finger lock with a knee bar on said lock. Fluries for days here. This is a climb for sloths. Oh I liked that cat Toast.
sweet jugs into p-good top. Munin ripping her hands on literally every burn! Impressive honestly.

Cool holds and big unique slightly awkward but fun crux move! I mean I did use the same start hold on Antaeus but I'm taking the flash here. Dear Toasters Dad, I'm sorry for snooping in your diary. Went through the depths of my 8a and I first discovered you in 2018 when climbing at Stinson beach. It was you Little Wing comment which showed me your 8a logging prowess. My soul is equally exposed here on 8a, and I love it. We are now 8a bonded. I cannot believe the cosmic forces at play here for Gregor Recian-God to finally meet you in real life. "Forgive us our sins as we forgive those who sin against us"

Another 4 star recommend!! God I can't believe id never even heard of this boulder before. And I would never have found it on my own. Thanks Aden for the stellar rec, and now I'm reccommending yalls, my loyal watchers to try this thing. Yes, my fellow senders/loggers are correct, the top is choss. BUT it's not dangerous, and does not detract from the glory in a serious way (at least in my completely objective and no bias opinion). Once the choss gets serious you are already on good feet. All the holds up to the lip are bullet and have lovely shapes. Also FYI - In Greek mythology, Antaeus was a Libyan giant, son of Poseidon and Gaea (Earth). Quality naming here Mr FA.

2 sessions. Pretty sure I would have single session if it wasn't end of day. Dyno is V nice. Sad I didn't send with my Mera Mera no Mi shorts on but at least I had my Calcifer socks into frame. Long live weebs!!! Aden arriving at clutch timing to cheer me as I stuck the dyno. I really just needed your eyeballs on me apparently to stick. This climb is beautiful.

What this, the Slashie, mean, is you consider me the best nine slash ten, and not the other way around. Taking 10 for Dungeon Master felt a bit bad, but taking it for both of these felt way too bad, so splitting the difference. Really, really, ridiculously good-looking pinches on this rigarino. Now time for a gasoline fight at Food Ranch followed by some orange mocha frapachino as long as the ants fit in the building. Check out my magnum, because wetness is the essence of moisture and I am beautiful. Mer-MAN!! pop. MER. MANNNN! Rest Daiye mañana.

The starting feature is unreal. How do you look at something like that and NOT want to do it. Maybe that's what Clark Kent thought when he saw her. With the high heel toe cam I got my fingies nicely inside that hole. Still big but much easier. Honestly a lot of these 10s feel a lot like V9sssssss parseltongue bitches! Amazing sessioning with Biscuit, Chad, Toast and Theo!! Excited to get back on The Superest of Men.

Actually p fun. Lovely holes and big moves. Me likey. Syndicate this trip is one of those climbs where I remembered it feeling close, and that memory made it feel so so hard this time. It's amazing how bad the rock quality is on the top of this boulder. Ned thinks this is harder than Kobra Kahn..... Was pretty sweet to roll up on Powerline as Theo rolls up Man from the Past.
Agree. Bizarre. But rad. Cool holds and crazy moves made this quite fun. Good temps help. Welcome back to Joes Woo and Balls! Fun working this with ya today.
ascents.sectorName: Cabin Fever / The Perimeter / The Death Scream Area

ascents.comment: Hard to give this 8 when Pimple took more burns but this feels like probably an 8. Not hard but not easy. If this was soft its be overdone... or maybe it just has a terrible name so it rarely gets done. Battletoads is still so so hard. Too cold. I want sleep. Woo woo choo choo
ascents.sectorName: Cabin Fever / The Perimeter / The Death Scream Area

ascents.comment: Wow. Second V11 and I'll take the softie. Agree that the actual difficulty is closer to 10 BUT that last move is epic. Absolutely and stellarly EPIC. Took our crew almost 2 hours on rope to find workable beta into the undercling, and when that move  finally fell the psyche skyrocketed. All my highballing helped me keep a cucumber head, but damn, it does take a special kind of climber to pull rigs like this. Need that iron heart, clear head and adamantium tits. Definitely need a crew for them pads. Really wanted the Woo Woo Choo Choo bc now I have to hike back up here with padsssss for my son. Anyway thanks for the support team, like., all of y'alls. Ned and Carina I can't believe your timing to show up AS I'm sending. You photo is sick Ned. This was #1 on my joes tick list and well, it's ticked. Take that Shirley, I beat you to 2 V11s.

It’s a rest day. But it still counts if I don’t use my hands! Honestly one of the cooler and definitely the hardest of the handless climbs I’ve done. Dont try to cheat and use shoulders or elbows or heads. Harness your inner goat

Remember trying this tipsy years ago. That’s was good fun. Goal today was to try lonesome but well Scott wanted to run and we had to say hi to the boys and we walked by this so I just had to. A quick 20 tries in cruisers and my days climbed metric was saved. Two rest days did not do a miracle my skin is leaving on a jet plane, just like my booty on this. Scott did you ever run today? Also good fun twerking myself into the big holes on great white. Honestly I want abs good enough to ab my way to the lip!

Honestly better than the original, and who knows, maybe this was the original First Ascentionists vision. That jag our right is pssshhhaw. Do dark continent up to the awesome cheese block then continue straight up. You do have to use that slightly choosy let facing jug but other than that holds are lovely. Not much harder than DC but a nice way to juice some more points out of them oranges. I doubt the is an FA. Also how TF could Scott do Albino Sea Snake but not this. Climbing is whack.

During said exploration we found this massive boulder. Scott only wanted to find cool overhangs so he quickly passed this by. If this was by the road it would be an ultra classic. Massive left facing ledge and rough 15 feet of relatively easy climbing. A bit mantley. Definitely some potential out here, but unfortunately nothing sick enough to get me back out here. Scott pulling a Davey and getting me psyched to do things not on the schedule.

Came out today to try Man from the Past and Couter clockwork but as days go with the boys, I never made it to either. Warmed up on this in the approaches to save my days climbed metric. Scott looked up the hill and said "Davy, come with me to explore yonder arete". So Scott and I explored the hillside searching for bounders. We found a few decent ones, but we were hoping to stumble on the next beyond life. We didn't.
I see no point in living if I can't flash this or send superman.

I love the starting feet. Post lust this trip was rough. High expectations without actualization led to big sad. Luckily the rest of the trip was gravy, but still hard to be swimming in gravy without extra gravy. Maybe I'll try lactation one more time today on my way out. Overall amazing freakin trip though. Born Slippy, Whorecore, Liars Dice, Rocks, Rolling (Smash), Work, Maggie, Triple Viderbation, Toaster, Theo, Tarp Police, Bitbucket License, Units, Espresso Machine, I miss my sons, I miss my Maggie. Don't be racist to Sour Patch kids my dames.

uuhhhhhhhh soft much? I thought the mantle was supposed to be the hard part but ALL of us (except balls) did it in iso in 3 or less tires (shoutout balls for sending that other rig tho!!!). Unfortunately the ice was too hight to do the first move so we had to do one move it. Soooooo I think V6 or V7 is fair from there. Yes im casting a massive shadow with my big dick but at the end of the day this climb is small and interesting. Certainly not a main attraction but really fun "stand" up mantle. This boulder looks way smaller in person.... maybe it was the ice. Yes I will be back for the full line.

Managed to avoid the Big Joe cave until today. And it fucked me. I'm so destroyed. Tryna get Pinchy on something before the airport, and well it was raining so this was the only choice. Actually pretty cool holds and moves but drop offs loose a lot of stars in my book. Hard to muster chutzpah and psyche especially when getting slapped. But I did finally do it and that's a days climbed metric BABY! My original plan to day was to sneak a burn or two on Lactation... I can't believe I was close yesterday with this desecrated body. No wonders that first move was so hard.  Amazing trip, but all good things must end. Excited to see my Maggie <3.

I wanted to text you a "Thank You" Kevin but I realized a 8a comment dedicated to you is more meaningful. Thank you for both the Bagels Hill Rec and the FERRO rec. We were too late to eat in at FERRO but we got takeout and it was delicious, definitely want to eat there next time since its got a sick vibe, Excited to get out with you again soon. Oh real quick aside to talk about this climb, probably first tried this a decade ago and tits always felt hard. Today it actually felt easy. wow. Its certainly easier than that unnamed V8 pat boardwalk,

I really don't line unnamed climbs =[. Poor climb. This was fun tho and Munin was so close! I think this is problem 543 in the book, I'm planning on double checking that number but I'll probably forget. This is the problem on the boulder just past Boardwalk. It starts on a very obvious black xeno and goes up to a mantle. Incredibly fun weekend with my love, Idyllwild Airbnb with great food, shoutout Raven Hill Bagels and FERRO, followed by a solid day at Tram, then quality fun in the sun at the Palm Springs Surf Club seeing Rico Nasty and Sara Landry.

PRNF: Couldn’t do tricks of the trade either. The big move is hard. Oh well. Thanks Drew for the support and surviving my Hot Girl playlist for hours on hours today. Left my organic strap system (bonus rachet inside) here. Sad. I guess finders keepers unless you read 8a religiously enough and frequent this crag and can snag it for me. Prime. Harder than it looks in approach shoes at least 🤷🏼. The face to the immediate right of tricks of the trade

PRNF: this might have a name it might be unknown. Thanks Drew for touring me even though you don’t have an A4. I’m glad you watched 2 of my burns before you went on a walk with your chungus.

Couldn’t do Shaolin Style (it’s p cool). This crag sets the definition of 5 star location. Anyway this boulder I logged is the jug line that goes up and right. Easy. Days climbed metric

Newlin is cool. Not only does Drew not have an A4 he got sick last night. But he still rallied to show me Newlin after work. Wanna come back for all the goodies in this canyon. Walk softly was a little too hard, megaladon was wet. William Schatner is added to my V12 wanted list.  Oh Drew also doesn’t have a Nalgene anymore bc it broke when he dropped it. Weird climb overall but cool holds and moves with some finish height!
Man if only I’d done this before dg crew rolled through.
Didn't use Kodys beta and it was still easy. He didn't believe me.
Kaya has V4 these days. Could see either. It's nice either way. Lots of jugs on a true roof to an interesting top! That dihedral out of the roof is fun!
Why do people not log the mods. Lazy. ALL OF YOU. Lazy. This climb is decent. So sad I couldn't quite pull horse fly. but TO BE FAIR, it was quite wet in the hole so we were skipping it.
enjoyable tension extension on Dharma Bums. Is it raining? no. Is it misting? maybe. Is it wet. most def.

Took a surprisingly long time to figure this one out. It's more of a traverse and down climb but at least the features are redeemable. Weird there isn't a climb that starts where the vertical part of the climb starts. Spanning is simply easier. Also again these tops scare me. I like don't intimately know this rock yet.

This boulder was hilarious bc our psyche was like zero as we walked up lol. BUT amazingly we pulled on and had a blast. The wetness was not great again. The beta we used made it p easy. Kody leading the charge. Yeah not topping out hurts my soul a bit.

Hard to find since Kaya has this as Second Wheel. Hardest I tried today for sure. Hardest in a looong while actually. Remember to turn on the try hard my dudes and dames. It gets shit done. I didn't want to blow the Choo Choo so I pulled with everything my soul could mustard. I honestly can't believe I didn't explode off at multiple points especially the final crimp which was definitely wet. Huzzah!! Another amazing  send train with Kody!! I missed this boy.

I got a good shin for this. Good send train Kody, Me then A4-less drewbie. Something about new areas make it scarier up high. You really do learn the rock. I guess. Awesome features on this. What in interesting climbing day.
This deserves the upgrade more than the mid deserved the DG.

Chase wont DG so I must. Colorado KAYA game seems kinda weak. Like you blew my flash on this bc i started one hold in. I haven't seen so many renames and unnecessary downgrades and in my whole life. Start on Sloper Jug? When the green line doesnt even go back to the actual Start. Lazy. I had to turn the "Try-Hard" on my " fake flash" bc i fucked up the stand beta and was relatively proud of myself for pushing through. Thank god Brett found beta for Kody bc he looked real bad.

I really liked this one, movement and simple vibe wise. Crimps are so enjoyable when you have a cam that good. This is silly tho when the right exit is so easy and obvious. Farts. Thirteen. Rolling 12 deep. Black is simply the best. Kenny hates climbing and just wants to mountain bike.

Good flash train Shirley. Lots of enjoyable trains this trip. Shriley looking in fine form. Good to have you back my guy. Lets get you outside!!! We both did the big move from different bad holds bc we are silly. Kinda coo that you can go left or right first move.

This was the coolest thing I did today. Thank you Hong. Did the high left heel betas bc im that rad. Tried the Sit once but traversing on into an obvious start hold felt a bit vile. Obvi if im in the area enough times ill eventually do it but not on my introduction trip. I'm glad the ladder and fan were finally used here. Im glad i never was in the Super Loser table.

The crux is that there are too many holds, hard to intuit the easiest beta instantly. Big holds on a steep feature is always fun. Shout out Drew for his impending metamorphosis into a tiny married man. That three over there is impossible with we4 sausages.

First go after left. Only slightly harder. Dragons Tail was not as cool as i thought it would be. Some super gross holds and its basically a traverse. Great job Shirly parching your double digit deprived mouth.
That pinch alone is 5 stars. Blew the flash bc it was wet and I started for the "low". Oh well. Waaayyyyy harder than it looks. More like V5.
Barefoot and wet. This boy is sexy as hell. With jugs like that i just wanna squeze em.

This was even wetter! Munin you looked soooo good on Jason the OG... in many ways 😏! If only it wasn't wet you would have shmanged. Oh well good excuse to touch you butt. Oh yeah this climb. This one is okay. Sidepulls are rad but a bit forced. slurp up that lerp to the lip for me.
It was moist. I was tired. But even without those two. This is hard. But good. Do it. you must. Bronsons will haunt my dreams until I come back.

Our day turned out perfect. Rain scared lots of peeps off but we got several glorious hours to explore LCC. I loved it. Started to drizzle here but we close to the car and all peetered out.

Aden i have a confession. I did not do Webbs Slab. I intentionally didn't download LCC in Kaya that way I was immersed in the here and now. I wanted no goals or expectations on my one day here. Anyway we knew Webbs slab was to the left of surfboard and this was the most obvious thing. Satisfying feet trust moves up to a rad finale to a jug. I will have to come back for webbbs slab so i can impress you. lol.
Not direct. had i known there was also a direct i would have done it. Approachies slipped on first go. I like mantles why did i not see it! Good escuse to touch great features again.
It does indeed live up to its very descriptive name. Our first send train nick!! Hopefully the first of many! Very fun
I disagree, I woudl say this is appealing. Aesthetic and climbs well. A nice crisp arete for lunch.

That chunk on the middle of this lip is oh so wonderful. Really makes this lowball quite amazing. Munin making moves on this! Figuring out balance and getting her outdoor game strong. Next time you send.
Yes yes very classic. Kowabunga my dudes.

That really was a surprise!!! Wow. Thanks 大 师兄 and Aden for the stellar recs on my short rainy but not rainy day! Thanks 大 师兄 for the deliciousioso expresso and pads and tour and good energy. Stoked to get out here again. Blue Steel in fall!!? Also shout out 大 师兄 on your send! your welcome.
INSANE. Like really? What unique movement. Preachy for sure but that homily is so so righteous.

I almost killed Munin today. kicked a branch off a tree and turns out I kicked the entire tree down . whoops. Nice dodge hun. Um, This climb is not V8. It's taken me years. Probably 10+ sessions, touch it every time I go to HG for a few hate burns. Fuel the rage. Drew couldn't do it a few years ago and I honestly wrote it off. Somehow today, high on my girl surviving another day, I pulled! Even today, I gave up on the "real" start and did a 2 pad stack thruching from the ground (which felt V8). After sending it that way, I said "check out my style" (didn't actually say it but I thought it). Maybe I'm actually stronger, maybe its actually V8 but this nemesis is ded. Final Round,, Fight! Game. Set. Match.

More rocks climbing.  Shoutout Paul, Erik and Biscuit for the post rain sends. I started @ Choice of Weapons and Traversed in. Almost had to face the dreaded goose egg bc Campground arete and River Face Arete are still effed. Good work Kody on the 20 year proj tho.
This is really hard for V0. Especially when compared to Problem B. Bad feet leads to some interesting options. Nice press Munin. Way to fight.

I probably did this in the past but i never logged!? Wow. This is a cool highball. I think we must have gotten the record for most people at Campground Boulder at one time? Go us! Congrats Drew + Jamie!

Wow this is amazing. First mutually new crag with Munin. She's rocking like 7 or so distinct crags with no overlap!! how is that possible!?? I really wont to come here in season with Kody and Marcus and Woo to scope for more bangers. I want to frolic all over this valley. Its so gorgeous. It was def too hot today, but such a beauteous crag. I always thought the Happies and Sads would be way more enjoyable with some trees, and that's exactly what this provides. Stellar feature.
ascents.zlaggableName: Church of the Lost and Found

ascents.comment: I like the right better than the left. Feels like the slightly more obvious line to me.
ascents.zlaggableName: Church of the Lost and Found (Right)

ascents.comment: This is the main reason I wanted to come to the Catacombs. Yes its tall. And yes that jug is friable. Pry that boy off and you might have a world class highball. As it stands it is still fantastic, a bit of balance into some big holds and some classic highball spice. Got some shakes today, either the coffee or the fact my shoes are melting off my feet. Im a beautiful man will have to wait until next time.

Wow tanner. A simple wrong would have done just fine.  Catacombs will never be someone's daily or weekly monthly or even yearly crag but as a little treat its lovely. Gorgeous setting with enough good climbing to merit some cheer. Take this climb, yes its sharp but it obvious and aesthetic (and even has killer name, cowboy hats off to the FA). The stronger boys were able to lock off that pocket, but us weak boys had to yeet and sticking the sharp jug felt vindictive. I will definitely be back to the catacombs. Thanks for spearheading this one Kody.
ascents.zlaggableName: Looks Like We're One Horse Shy Partner

ascents.comment: At least its not unnamed. Much more better. Quality KodyDavidDavidMarcus centipede up this. Way better than a train which is why i upgraded my verbiage to centipede. So visceral.

PRNF. Somehow couldn't find this on MP or KAYA, so adding a placeholder name that is NOT "unnamed". This is an easy V0 on the left just past the Devil boulder when walking to the church. Fantastic jugs make for real enjoyable climbing. Pull out not down

This is actually okay. Between The Stig and Choice Choss there is a boulder. on the south east corner near where "The Stig Left" tops out there is a small overhang. Start on the obvious big right facing edge and make one left hand move up the same feature then lock off to the lip. Short but not terrible. There is a surprisingly hard project to the left of this. Two obvious opposign holds but really hard to pull on. Looks like one lerp to the lip. At least V7. I came to woodson today to film the last boulder i needed for my Hanging Garden Video.... and dang i could only do SEASONED V7 in 3 parts. I think that might be V8.

Forced but I wanted a line that actually started on the East face of the Stig boulder. Stat sitting with a righ thand bad gaston and a left hand on the xeno. Use some okay feed out right to get pressed and top out "The Stig Left". Right arete is OFF. This will be more obvious once tree is truly gone.

This will be even better once the tree is fully collapsed, but pretty enjoyable warm up with some cool holds. Start on the same corner as the OG stig, but start on the LEFT side of the arete. Make your way diagonally up and left under the tree (while its still there) and top out on the beautiful arete on the left side of that face. I touched PO today... boo. Might be FA since tree was blocking top out until an unstoppable force came?

The Uphill face of the obvious outlook boulder in the tree switchbacks of the Timber Gap Trail. This boulder quality is god awful but its got a pretty location. Start on pretty good underclings at the base of the V feature. Make one non trivial move up and left to a good hold then continue up being careful to not rip every hold off.

Would get more than 1 start if not for the terrible rock quality. Do the right of crumbl there is an obvious finger crack. After on move in the crack you can reach bigger holds that are quite rippable. Be careful.

Compared to Crumbl this rock quality seems like a godsend. This boulder is about 150 feet uphill from Crumbl, and this line is the downhill left corner. Start on an obvious right hand jug and left hand on the first sloping shelf. Put some feet on and slap around the corner to a nice hold then work feet up to even maybe a heel until you can reach right hand to the true jug. From then just top out.

I mean if it wasn't mini it might actually be good. But alas. It's forced beyond belief, but at least the features are nice. On the Timber Paradise ridge this is in the first granite talus cluster of mini boulders when walking from timber toward paradise. Start on the detached flake jug and move left through the crack and topping out on the left chunk.

Now this one is actually decent and the direct jug line will be even better. Obvious boulder near sapling seam (like 150 feet toward timber). Start on the left facing jugs, use the sweet-as-jug-side-under-pull then bail out right on some better holds.

Small like everything around. But we get to hump the crap out of it to get on top so thats a plus. In the little granite cluster of minis on TP Ridge, this is a small roof with an obvious jug beneath a beach whale of a top out. Slap to lip, bump to side pulling hold, throw foot up then beach whale. Might be V1 but take the hiking point.

Holy cow. That was insane. Climbed this during MASSIVE rolling thunder. One of the most memorable Eagle Lake hikes. Chance of sprinkles turned into actual snow. like gods honest sticking snow. Magical. What a great first MK experience for my Munin. Honestly I like this better than OG Vaskular. Big move up n right to nice hold.
Coolish looking with large feature. Must climb conditions. Even if short and not amazing. Must. I cannot resist.
AKA "Not a Crack". It is. But its so easy. It isn't. Moderately aesthetic and easy so i did it.

This climb is not good. But its in a p-cool cluster. That mini over hang with da pinch looks fun. What i thought was going to be the starting hold ripped riiiiight off so was not the start hold. Our Surfliner plan failed yesterday bc there was a train semi collision, so ended up driving all the way to SD and back lol. At least i got to grab some fresh eggs from the neithbors and get 3 kitty hugs. Amaxing first trip love. Even for crappy lines like this... never stop exploring. Rocks wont find themselves.

First tried this probably a decade ago now. It's very obvious. Kind of a stupid boulder but its shape is undeniable unique. Like a rodent or anteater coming to the surface of this granite ridge to get a breath of fresh air. IF more things come to existence in this psuedo peak it might merit its own micro crag name. Thinking "Animal Kingdom". Came here specifically for what ive been calling in my head "Queen Caterpillar". One pad was not enough for that monster, but it is incredible feeling and looking and i wanna come back for it. Anyway okay, start thsi climb low on teh left arete with both hands and toe-hooks out right. P cool and gimmicky. This start option make is height dependent but it was too fun to NOT do it that way. Unfortunately the Proboscis of the Anteater is so breakable sounding so try not to yar on it. If it was bullet this woudl get another star.
Short but actually real nice. The jug line up the west side of the swallowtail boulder. This name is a shoutout to our furry friends, the marmots. Several seem to live under this boulder.

Tried this in my cruisers and could not do it. Another great slab nestled on a ridge with a gorgeous panorama, gave me "City of Ancients" vibes so wanted to shout that out. Also wanted to shout out "crystal" and "monarch". Porcelain seems close enough to crystal and well butterflies is obvious. It was p cool to hike down to Crystal lake and look back up at the ridge bc this slab is obvious. Really good line. Just hard to get to lol.

Might Be V0, and really looks like V0 with how big the holds are but I felt like i tried harder than V0. Short left to right arete with cool big holds. Maybe lack of feet makes it harder? In any case get these free points! Just uphill from Larvarete before False Wittness.

Tiny but doable. A small arete on the left side of the Flutter boulder. The most satisfying part is that ther is an obvious jug once you warp onto the main "Flutter By" face. Basically pull off the ground and make 2 moves until compression shows up and just bump to the jug and top out in that wittle scoop. I am out of shape... or im tired. I could have sworn i got to Monarch with a PAd in 45 minutes. It took me an hour 20 today

Wow. Very obvious boulder. Too bad its not a little harder. Toward the back end of Upper Monarch Lake there is a face with a big ledge near the bottom. Sit start that ledge and mantle onto it. From there you can simply reach the lip . Such a big shelf you could put books on it. heh heh heh.

Another arete near the lakeside. Start on a ledge just below the arete and make one move up the the sharp arete and follow  it up to the main lip of the boulder, ideally mantling right for full value. Def a worthwhile little guy

How had I not see this boulder before? The lip traverse is going to be a wonderful addition to Monarch Lake. It was too scary without a pad. I envision one early exit on the good lip edges, and a harder line that continues to the left arete. I assume this boulder was too close to the lake for me to have noticed it before. Big sad. Anyway for this line start with right hand on the obvious xeno above the lip and just pull onto the slab.
Classic only because its classic.
Fun. Weird that it gets harder once you hit the jug. Didn't expect that. Loved meeting Reese and Roman today!
I am weak. reach to compensate.
Cool features. Munin so could have gotten this one!!! So close love. Fun to see you be able to work a climb even with the right fingie injuries tho
rad start hold meh rest.

This is a fantastic V0. Other 0s shoudl take note. True juggos! Such a wonderful time up here for 4th of July Weekend meeting Magdalenes family. Thank you so much for spending so much quality time with us. I loved the Rackaway beach firework show (even tho we got home crazy late), and i like just seeing the beautiful foresty city. Excited to come back not weak and do more here at carver!!! (and get more out of my carver clibing membership lol)
Actually okay. Mobbin is better tho.
I think i logged the right thing? The small arete on teh boulder adjacent to teh COlombia boulder just to teh left of Trask. Why "4C" "5A" is fine.
Meh, more points. Felt like i was gonna rip that start hold. eek.
This is good fun. Almost tooooo many good feature. So gorgeous out here. LIke a MORE foresty squamish. COmplete with river view. I wanna come back!
Hard for V2, but mostly bc of that off balance first move. Loved Munin stickign that first move then lookign right at me lol. 100% would have done this earlier in teh day.
Heel toe cams are fun. Good finale before river diiiiip!
Very good. Nice work Munin figuring out the first move. Lets get your body fully healthy so we can start slaying boulders and dragons.

The Kaya Video i saw was NOT correct. This climb off routes all the jugs. Jump from the two side pulls, yes that not so good right hand one BEFORE the jug. all teh way to the lip. It is enjoyable. That top out is all time. Such a frictiony, good angled lip. a perfect scoopable to just pres yourself up and out.
Last second pointzzzzzz

I LOVE that a V0 made front page. It really is quite good. Perfect height with that ultra classic ledge part way up. Slabby and mantely deliciousness. If it wasn't her first day back, if we had more pads, if it wasn't first climb of the day, we might have gotten Munin up this babygirl. Carver is lovely. One of those areas that have quite a unique personality!

Yep this one is a goodie. Harder than I expectd but i have a sneaking suspicion im weak rn. boo. Awesome holds, good moves, aesthetic and beautiful location. A little scary with only one pad but def doable. So stoked Munin found this lovely little crag for our trip up to Vancouver WA.

Another one I can't believe I never looked at. Im sure the big slab also goes and I think that prevented me from looking at the face to the right. Start on some slightly friable shit, but the climb up the slightly tall low angle face to larger and more appealing holds as you ascent. I am a chunky monkey. YOU are a chunky monkey. We ALL are chunky monkeys.

Decent arete next to Eagle Creek right before the lake, Start chest high on a good uncut then move to the arete and continue up. Good rock makes the movement even better. Surprised id overlooked this boulder until this year.
Im sad that there are boulders blocking a true sit start bc it would have been better. You can still sit start but you are kind of contorting to not touch them.
On the west side of the same boulder as mantle practice. Also a bit smoll but the nice edges make for a few nice moves. Right facing holds left facing smears.
I dare say there may be TOO many features on this. Coolio. Face to the right of Grand Junction.

Whoa. This is cool. Crux is the final move which is a bit worrisome on a highball V1, but cool slabby aretty. Big stainable ledge half way up at the "junction" heehee, before committing to the sloppy top.

Also awesome. Instead of starting on the left side of the arete, start sitting on the right side of the arete. Climb bye though the ledge then use the rad right facing feature to do a hard squeezey move at the top. Another V1 with too hard of a move up top. both variations are so sweet!

That was fun! Jump to big ledge then find a way to pull or press it out! Angle of face is too steep to true out of the pool so using some subtle slopers can help with your mantle. Thought of Aden  when sending this one, because he likes mantles too.
Quality easy low ball mantles are hard to find. That's probably because they are smoll. But this guy is great for you folks looking to practice easy mantles.
Sit start on the big ledge of the toward the left side of the Staircase wall. Get on that ledge and go basically straight up through a big matchable xeno below the jug seam.
Start as per "My Main Man Mr Xeno" but go king big left into that sweet sweet big plate xeno on the far left of the boulder.

God intended this as a jump from the roof on bad feet to the massive jug. BUT that's way too scary without at least 3... no 4 pads. This variation starts already on the jug, which you need to scramble up adjacent boulders to get to. Despite starting 95 percent up the boulder it's not a gimme. Feels exposed and you gotta pack you big boy mantle trust pants.

A little short but the view is gorgeous here! You can see that awesome double saw blade (Mineral Peak + Sawtooth Peak). Near the end of the granite switchbackies this is off the trail to the arete. Funner starting with left hand underclinging the face and right on the arete.

After MSMMMSS probably the most obvious rock. It's on the north shore by that tree. This is the obvious line on the north side starting at the base of the small dihedral. Sit start slightly lower than you want to so you can lie back a bit before pulling into the little dihedral to top. Somebody probably climbed this before me since well the history or the world is kind long. No way I could ever dig up enough graces to summon undead and ask even single human who lived before me. But whatever, take the FA. I knight thee.

Actually my favorite on this boulder. I thought it would either be too easy or too silly but the buggy features are at cool angles to make some fun moves. Sit start let hand on the arete and right on the cool crescent jug feature.
Don't know where this name came from. Divine intervention maybe. On the side opposite the tree there is a arete like feature you can sit start.
Start just the the right of the obvious staircase and climb up some fun xenos. This warm up wall is incredible. Xenos in MK hit different

A few years ago the boulder fell onto the trail near. It's a very forced line as you can step onto the boulder from the trail. But it's possible to mantle, so ofc I did! start sitting ass on the trail on the relatively obvious flake edge. Get that left leg up and just mantle.
Equally mediocre as it is long. But it's a long enough to get some moves. This is the furthest behind on logging I have ever been

This is not a flash bc I tried it in my sandals when Eileen found it in June. Super obvious warm up wall with Xenos out the wazoo. Right at the top of the granite talus climb, this wall is on the right up the hill some. There will be man variations possible. This one actually doesn't use any xenon bc it climbs the super obvious Staircase Feature . Cruk is once the jags run out and you have to rock onto of the last step. Amazing wall good find Eileen.
Sit start beneath where "The Long Lip" tops out. Pull onto the ledge and to a small pop or long span to the better holds above. Also highly maybe only okay.

Oddly enough there are enough jugs you don't really need that many xenos for this one. But this whole wall is full of delicious xenos so name is still apt. Start on the center of The Staircase wall and go almost straight up on the slightly right trending cracks with a little help from your xeno friends

Awesome starting feature. BIG move to some not as good holds. Like that starting feature is so alluring it alone makes this climb,. Steep move so it's actually kind of a tough throw. This name is a shout out to me the one true Keyless King., I lost my keys once on a mountain top, and this time I dropped them on the trail... so after an 18 mile day of hunting for boulders I had to run an extra 5 miles down to Silver City to get water and a place to sleep... Toyota how can you call yourself an outdoor brand if your remote unlock / start feature only works with cell service?!?! I called support and they told me to call 911 if I felt I was in danger... if I had a starlink I could have started my car... ridiculous. Huge shoutout to my dad for driving my key 10 ish hours for me. Glad someone turned them into the ranger station to save him some time.
Piece of cake. But kind of tall so keep your wits. This boulder has some cool lines on the west side I was not able to do! get on it.

This climb was actually kind of bad, but I had to do it to celebrate the fact I found some cool boulders id never seen before. In a small cluster half way straight down fro Franklin pass to the Infinity Pool

Climbs like this are CRAZY. There are island xenos separating slightly chossy granite. Basically looks like someone glued xenon perfectly on the beast. P cool that you only need xenon (until top). Don't forget your pokeballs

Good eye Munin! Bert lives!!!! Surprisingly fun for how short it is. The small face opposite Saddle Arete. Start in the horizontal feature and makes some moves up then mantle. I used a toe hook I rode the whole time.

Never tried this boulder before!! What a good find and yet another good place to watch sunset. RIP watermelon jar. Good one for Munin next time! PERFECT top out. A bit sharp but this really is quite enjoyable.
Super cool.

8a developers please make an easier way to know when a destination has the distinction of Area vs Crag. I hate when adding new boulders to somewhere like Black Mountain and accidentally adding the to AREA-Black Mountain CRAG-Black Mountain. Exacerbated by the fact that its impossible to MOVE a climb one you made it. I would have to delete then recreate which is too much work for a man like me. This climb was not great. had to try quite hard.
Not as good as the left but it's p good. Get on top to soak up some sunset!
Fun day out with a fun crewwww. Sephie brought Me Maggie Michelle and Krista out for a good time. A bit hot but fun. Loved Kristas parasail.
Kinda hard first move for v2 but was enjoyable. Hot day.

Tried the sit a few times in the heat but came for the view and the camaraderie. Sending "Once Upon a Time" again with Michelle was pretty grate. Really fun to show Munin and Krista the epic-ness of that.
the guide doesn't have this one listed but it feels like maybe the most obvious. Just ride the jugs the way they want want to be ridden.

This climb is legendary. Looked that from the road many times but figured it was too terrifying to do without a rope. (There are bolts on top!, That's how I know it's not an FA but it might be the first free?). This Chasm is SO SICK.  You can squeeze in sideways from 3 different entrances. This climb is just 40 foot chimney. There is a striking arete you could use in the chasm but you don't really need it. You could use it. so many options. This chasm is so cool.
Water sculpted stemming feature awesomeness. What a gorgeous spot with gorgeous waterfall. I bet someone has done this before but I am FA monster. gobble gobble.
If you couldn't tell from the name this really isn that good. There's a ledge, I climbed dit end of story. Maggie is working at the Restuaratnt! Must get back to my honey

Some names just come to you. I love GameChops for my bouldering videos and I think there's an album called Chilltendo. Anyway som really cool boulders right here at the ridge between minerals. An easy slab but it's really fun. Fantastic view.
The features on the arete are so cool that it deserves a name. Its a slab but there cool pinches that are crazy good but you don't need them which is a bit sad. but you can touch the bc its nice to .

Stormfather boulder is legit... but somehow it distracted me from this beauty. Mab: Queen of Air and darkness, the project is born. Seriously awesome, and there is gonna be several lines not eh boulder,. This line is a slightly highball slab but you hit jugs so that's nice.
The feature is as obvious as the name. Too bad the climb is not harder. But good features with jugs are cool.

This is the name of my auto water cycle for my lawn. AKA the poop plantation., Calling this in memory of that sprinkler cycle bc marmots have pooped up here for generations. On the mineral creek trail up to the lakes this is at one of the talus fields. Some jugs lead up to the wonderfully poop filled look out.

Whoa. Crazy bouler... or maybe unlikely "stack" of boulders. All I can recommend is not taking a Chidori to the face otherwise you might look like this rock. Started from the bottom left and worked up and right through this easy highball.
A sharp arete that marks the trail. Stay sharp out here folks.

Maggies first FA is a banger. Also MK is her first duplicated crag. Insane. We did it. She got 10 unique crags before doubling up.  If you cant tell by all the names... lots of xenos out here. Such an awesome Mk trip with my love <3. Sephie took good care of us. What a trooper Munin. looooooong day of hiking
I named too many boulders things that start with "xeno". If I'm confused all the hordes of people who flock to MK will also be confused. good luck!
It's literally like some gnome came up here and started gluing black chunks of rock on the granite up here. wow. This one also has a crach you use. fun!
Boulder on MAUIIIII rally!!??? That was fun. Id come back. This climb has some sweet pockets.
No pad hits different. One hard move from a hold worse then you want especially when the holds all feel like Dennys plates. hot syrupy ones. Fun sunset out here by myslef

FUN! and a nice final prize for the day. Harder than it looks until you figure it out! Then you are tired with no skin so it feels hard again. I pulled it though!!! Great end to mini crag day. MP gave this somewhere between 7-9 but if you are tall enough spanning makes it not too bad at all.
Did I mention Dennys plates? interesting sequence to get from rad start horizontal rail to the bit jug.
It's tryna rain but we gotta see our boy and set sail. These features are cool. Woulda been real sweet on an overhang but easy climbs deserve cool features too
Touching more amazing features. EZ PEE Z. The rain cometh! We mush hop on Maiden Voyage, hurry!

Did not start sitting, Whoops. When there's too many rad jugs sometimes you start on the wrong one. Amazing session with Woo, Jordan, Christine, Owen and Nick. An hour and a half and near giving up when the crux finally dropped. Key hold missed by Woo and I in our hurry to get her done before the rains came. But with the power of friendship we persevered. Once beta was unlocked we proceeded to attach our mouths to each others assholes and trained up this beast. Yes Tunnicliffe you get a special shoutout for pointing out that hold, we NEEDED you. Amazing line both Kody and Ice, thank you for birthing this, The new age highballs at black are unreal. How were there still so many untapped gems. Get on this SoCal, it's dope. So techy.
It's a move! You pull on and do a thing! Could be worse. Im warm now and ready to get high,
Wanted to secure my days climbed metric and this had chalk on it. Quite fun! A bit of spice bc of tiered landing, but actually great and worth doing. I Animal in the morning is actually a good choice
Also a super good virtually never done climb. Starts on rad jugs, then tops out twice. That ledge you can stand, crawl, walk, grow old together on is rad.

Wow trying to think of the "best" V5 on the mountain is hard. Black is really not know for V5s apparently. I mean it would be Quivering Lips be we all know that is not really V5. Anyway, this climb is super good and would be in discussions for better V5s on the mountain. Good find Kody. Fun season opener with Kevin and David Woo. Woo the efficiency of our late arrival sleep in the Sephi is up for debate. Sorry about all the cat i shoved up your nose

2nd ascent, might be for the best bc this would have been named "Milk My Kitty". If someone set this inside i would call them high as titties "You would NEVER find that outside". Turns out theres lotsa rock and it all exists somewhere in the universe. As woo said sharpness is the only detractor but this is such a wild and unique climb that is a fantastic addition to Black. There arent many crazy dynos here so I hope despite being in deep black this climb gets some traction; probably wont tho since Hustler of Culture is absolutely stellar and has so few ascents. Maybe all  Deep Black needed was a sideways slab dyno to spart a revolution! Anyway CRAZY sequence getting from the massive Hustler start to get set up in that undercling. Literally grabbed that hold three different ways: On the dop as a sharp crimp, thumb and pointer pinch like im milking my cat, and finally the undercling which is how it wants to be held. We spent forever trying to find ANYTHING else on the face to help, but once we committed to just yeeting from the undercling and good feet, we ally-ooped that shit. Small box Big Box type of guy, right foot in my ass fun and huge dyno. Fell so so many times.
Number 29 in the Silver Fox Topo. Its a split boulder and Kaya wont like duplicated names like Unnamed Arete so creative liberty here. THank god im a guidebook author.

Kinda cool but also kinda dumb. I really just wanted to match the horizontal jug and go right but the lines says you must go up and left. first three holds are p-cool but nothign to write home about overall. Tried sans pad and was a bit scared so I reccommend a pad.
I do think this deserves V8, even if its low end its pretty mega. Proud and beautiful. My top out sequence involved not one but TWO toe hooks. Again ladder ftw. Need to get deep more often!

Awesome lie back under cling to the left of "Hustler of Culture". I had this name teed up for the gymtastic sideways slab dyno as a shoutout to the ludicrous pointer+thumb pinch move, but when woo snaked I couldn't let my genius name go to waste. Consolation FA, although i really hope this isn't actually an FA and the developers were just too lazy to add it. I do have the vision tho soooo it really could be. The top out of this is the biggest xeno you've ever seen.
Its K. Nice to have full suite of warm ups on one boulder tho.
Cool start holds, then confusing not so great middle face, then good top out holds. Again good for the comprehensive warm up but harder than it looks.

Another one up there for best V5s on the mountain? Again crazy how small this pool is.  Awesome day getting deep wit da boyz. Quality warm up train for a Grecian-Woo-Scott Choo Choo. Story of the day for Kevin is too many small boxes. Sephi rocked the road (dang im glad to finally have a car that can make it to deep black), and fit three boys and like 7 pads. Awesome looking rock, fun juggy moves to the slightly technical top. Would maybe be better if the top was a tad easier for consistency? Either way absolutely worth doing and fun time. I am so dependent on a ladder at this point is impressive.

Holy shit what a revival of the true meaning of Woo Woo Choo Choo!!! 🚆🚆!!! Alley-opp took all my skin and honestly all of my strength, when you deck 8+ times on a horizontal sideways dyno it really takes a toll on a 30+ year old body. I think i got shin splints from those falls alone. Kevin literally cruised this thing, hats off to your current training cycle. You better slay the mountain this season. I was consistently hitting the big span but my tired booty couldn't do the second section so i gave up. Woo however did not, that stubborn sun of a bitch took so much time flailing then resting its like oh my god. I would never make my crew wait 3+ hours as i fall on the final dyno of a climb that wasnt even on the lesson plan. I would never. Anyway, woo somehow packed all the chutzpah his little mouth could swallow and yeeted his yacht all over this piece. It was my obligation to go for the choo choo and somehow, the power of the choo yanked me upward. Horrible horrible style at the top but i was fully pumped and started chimpanzeeing to the jugs. Honestly almost fell and the full buckets bc i was fully pumped. Fantastic day
YOu can climb this without detaching your right elbow from your side. I know from experience. Nice jugs.

Quite good. I am flabbergasted. Last night I could no longer lift my arm. I mean we are climbers we alwasy have pain somewhere, but wow, got up off the couch after an episode of Gachiakuta and literally could not lift it. Alrady comitted to black so figured i could at least be pad sherpa to woo. Like a Deus Ex Machina, Christine was here today and she showed me her PT prowess. I am a new man who will hopefully use this as the kick in the but i needed to fix my bad shoulder posture. engage those rhomboids and lower lats my dudes. Next level of climbing unlocked. Thanks infinitely Christine. This climb was my glorious return. So stoked to get out to deeeeep blaaaccckkkm oreee. This is a nice tall slab with super cool features and easy climbing up high. The underclinging crease is pretty cool. Definitly worth a climb.

Oooph what a day. Slowly sticking most of the moves on Hug-a-war, except the crux of course. I toughed this years ago. Many years. Like 10. probably more. Still taking flash. Felt a bit hard for 3 maybe? But maybe its just because i could even lift my arm a few hours ago. Fun double roping Silver Fox direct and The Strangest Thing with woo. Ice you are a mad laddddd. Inspired FA on that latter. Stoked on the Geddan Slab project aka Nuts in a Vice. Or maybe i could name that one Milk my Kitty? Too bad the gate closed prematurely. Now i gotta walk 10 pads really really far.
A day of easy things and things on rope. Enjoyable slab directly behind you when looking at Styx Face. Unnamed in the book. Thank god im a guidebook author.

I wanted to climb a rock in Australia. I did. Tyler and I tried to get to "Peak Hill" but I am not versed enough in the bush to be willing to bushwhack up to the boulders. I could see them from the freeway so it was quite sad to not be able to make it. Anyway, big shoutout to Tyler for encouraging us to keep looking for boulders. Play Pen is really a rope climbing spot which is why i was originally hesitant, but hey it had easy access and I was able to climb this super easy highball. So sad that Rocky Climb was not open yet. Would have been incredible to have a climbing gym while out here.

anyway, don't know if i did the true line as described in "The Crag". I staryed on big blocky ledges then cut right through jugs. A bit highball for first boulder in a new country but i was stoked to get a real climb in.

There was chalk on this so its definitely been done before. BUT it was an actual boulder here. Just down hill from the other climb I did "Lichen the Colours", but still on same tier as the "Main Wall". Its a slightly overhung arete trending slightly right. Sit start at the bottom of the aerate with good edges on the left side of the arete, without good feed. my left leg was flagging way into the split between boulders. Big ish first move then a cool match then hope the rock doesn't break and your hand done wet fire.
Pull out not down. Fun final excusion with Ryan and Tyler. From sunny so squall in tiny moments. THis rock is terrible.

Favorite climb of the day!! If this was in the basin it would be SUPER popular. You do start on a "detached" chunk but on climbs like this it is way more correct and natural like the gods intended. The OG beta might be a bit peachy but pretty sure there are some wittle crimps that are plenty sufficient considering the big feet to make it work as a shortie. Cool features with nice moves up to a bit committing but easy top (just like the book says). Very easy to spot the top though so no worries whatsoever. Winter days stink..., so short! 2.5 hour drive + 2 hour bike ride + ? climb time + 1.25 hour bike ride + 2.5 hour drive = sunny time... solve for ? climb time. Answer... very little. Didn't get to boulders until 12:43 and left at 3:45. That's a lot of effort for 3 hours of climbing,

Woof woof I'm a doggy. Props to the store masters for their classy vision and ability to press out crazy things and slab with the best of em. This guy was harder than I expected, feet are quite bad. To be fair (TO BE FAIR!), I just biked 6.5 miles up hill on a torn apart road through snow on a simple gravel bike with a crash pad... wow. I really thought that would be easier. The next day my chest hurt and all the little muscles between the ribs.. I think that was probably from bracing all the bumps on thew ay down on a bike without suspension. wowzer... I do want to finish the deep black mapping before spring but damn... with the gate closing super early this is a bit effed. Thank goodness I love type 2 fun. Anyone got a e-mountain bike I can borrow?
Really hard to distinguish between 2 and 3. A bit of a gimmick climb but it's really fun to find these gems in nature. The balance tech to mount the underclinging lip is quite good! Enjoyed muchly.
Might actually only be class 4 even from a sit. The rightward facing feature is cool but the angle is so low it's rather trivial. I did it though. This is the easy slab on the Wraith Slab boulder
Block is still just as sure loose. So loose you might just get lucky ;P
Meh. The lip of this slab wall is all time. Would be better without the rock in the landing so you had more climbing.
It's a slab with enough things to climb it like a slab. many options, use feet and hands climb yes.

Yes only move of any difficulty is the first one. Kevin I'm going have to check the tape to make sure you started in the right place. 8A policia coming after you! JK. Wish you were out here with me today. Brutal day but this climb is nice. Lowball with some stellar holds with great rock quality. Certainly not the most inspiring line but it's fun. The start is a tad ambiguous bc the left hand is obvious but where does the right hand go? I had a delicious Eppig tart fruit ale to finish my chronicle on the mountain today. It was good. Also this boy is Very soft. Was worried I was grade inflating the other things I graded but oof campfire press took way more tired and effort than this and im known for my orange juice makers.
ascents.zlaggableName: Three Strokes of a Cow's Udder

ascents.comment: That was wow hard for a green, Also wow sharp that starting hold. Giving this high end of green bc it deserves it. Not terrible, would be an AMAZING final move of a tall climb but low to the ground with an awkward landing somehow makes it so-so.
Cusp of V1. Really cool crux sequence! Such a perfect hold in the middle of the face. Only down side is the "chock stones" in the crack that add uncertainty and sub par rock quality.

This was pretty fun! Arete alone isn't too bad, most of the difficulty is just the first sequence getting to the arete, then its just an enjoyable arete ride. Why do you need friends when you have..? How does that joke go again?

A boulder literally on the Corral trail that i haven't touched!? handful of problems on the guy that are decent place to start. Maybe not best warm up since its slabs and some sharp crimps, but its fun! The slabs are all pretty tall and feel quite exposed! This one was delicate up high but enjoyable. This time my are was wroking but i recently fell rollerblading and so my right wrist hurts. Can pull on it in most directions but pushing is rought. Matling and spotting are right out. Please heal quick

Those jugs are drooltastic. Almost a really good climb. It has all the makings. Tall Proud, has jug, but a few things are sad. Friable Gaston early. too many holds--a lunge to the jug would be rad, and top out is meh, would be sweet if it felt natural to ride the high lip to the apex, but it's easier to just slopily mantle. was worth doing, woo with the choo choo to ensure we tied points today.

Felt really hard but as per my Magical Octopus comment mantles are right out, so even this V0 ish one felt hard. Startign jug is rad then its like the holds go away for a while. Cool pinch up high, but its over by that point. Just is a biiiiit flexy but its k. This is actually the downclimb.

Woo didn't want to stage clear the boulder. Shame on him. He wanted to save himself for marriage... i mean SoCal Royalty. He DID find pretty sweet beta for the rip, but flopped like a fish on that first move that drew literally cruises. Anyway, this one is interesting. Also tallish and feels exposed. no hand start  onto the foot is p cool. Hard to tell slab difficulty but this might be easier than Magical Octopus? Slab is fun bc you dont need to be strong.
This was actually pretty good! Hard for 3 bc the feed are so bad and the crux is so directional, but the holds are cool. Was worth doing in an attempt to get more points than Woo

This is cool. And it was by reassurance on Days Climbed metric. Oof today was rough. Although I guess it was bound to be, haven't climbed at all since December 20th, but I did pull on a little wooded block at least once a week between that. Isnt that enough for a Grecian God to stay godly? I guess not. $500 shut me down, then Orange Top took the wind from my nonexistent metaphorical sails. Oh also my wrist still hurts from when I fell roller blading early December. Orange Top was aggravating it. Can wait to fall off of orange top next time im in RR too. This climb must be cleaning up bc its wasn't too sandy but was p nice.

Oh... Woocifer, when you smile I am undone
My son. Look at my son
Pride is not the word I'm looking for

There is so much more inside me now
Oh, Woocifer, you outshine the morning sun
My son
When you smile, I fall apart
And I thought I was so smart

My father wasn't around

AKA "Little Fishies" as per out beloved woo. After my magnificent showing yesterday I could not believe I pulled this. Means it must be easier than Jack of All Trades. Indeed it has dab potential, but honestly it did not detract from the climb to me. It makes the rip crux, and besides that move not dabbing is fine. Rock is gorgeous and movement is awesome. Holds are also cool. Amazing rec Michelle. PS I got to share a bed with Woo this trip which was plush.

I think some things have broke and are going to continue to break. BUT we had fun. Started matched on the undercling and moved to the arete then up. Beautiful day out! Thanks for hosting Michelle, and Woo always a pleasure climbing with you. Krista next time I wanna see you more!

My foot slipped pulling off the ground lol. So unique, Short but beautiful rock and genuine fun. Good laughs guaranteed. Did the first time as boring lock off, second time I did the obligatory backward. Woo nice strip tease. Don't get the boulder too greasy now.

Awesome send train to end the trip. Gorgeous boulder in a ridiculous location. This is hard, but slab always is. It's definitely easier than Bathtub which is probably how we decided on V4? Had to crimp like the dickens. Honestly could see V5 or V6. Not too much choss anymore (well besides some of those top jugs but its eaaaasy then). highly recommend this. Fantastic end to the trip. Thank you Michelle Woo and Krista for a fantastic weekend. Love and Peace,

Some recent traffic has even been giving this V5 but it's pretty beta choice dependent. I did toe hooks but not a true bat hang.  Did the rad recycle thing, but after hitting the lip I brought feet back left into a reverse bicycle thing to match. Incredible location and fun climbing regardless. Sit felt nails.
Pretty fun actually. A bit scary to do tenuous moves on RR sandstone that has not been trial tested yet, when the landing is sub par. Fun though. nice and balance and high feet crux.

This climb is awesome. At the V1/2 level it doesn't really get better than this. Great location, aesthetic, good holds. Only detractors are the dabby rock to your left at the start and the super interesting top out. Wow. That lip is so sharp that when you are topping out it feels like you are just as likely to topple off that side lol. Quite good and a pleasant start to the day. Swing for style on the lip. Michelle and Woo you need yo work on your swings.
Michelle blowing the flash train was almost as hilarious as Woo Falcon elbowing the shelf. Needs some serious traffic to clean up but then might eventually be a 2 star line.

This was actually super good! High quality lip and interesting mantle. The texture oin the lip si all time. Almost as textured as that moss project sloper! Natebro is my guy. Lets get you climbing regularly again. Slab is long and tall and full of lichen. Either clean it with a wire brush or just jump down after mantling. I will sign your scorecard.

one move crimp test. Would be a pretty cool last move of a longer climb, but one movers, on some less than bullet holds are silly. Points though. Plus despite being kind of weak my crimping on my spider chard is proportionally large.

SO MANY MANTLES ON ONE BOULDER. Easiest one was actually Bleau Jump but my son totally wiffed it and there was a one of anything on the line. Unfortunate to do so many mantles with an ailing wrist. Im proud of my son for his naked fearlessness, but im also glad i do not owe him one of anything. Inching closer to makign the Mile bet official. Awesome work BTW on actually pulling BLeau Jump after lookign terrible for hours after that flash attempt.

Great Job my Munin.  You are now an official yeet machine and you got your days climbed metric with this piece. We been off the climbing horse of late so showing up with some outdoor slab skills was sweet. Can believe you ended up being sick, making the long mountain day even more impressive.
