Glad we brought Rune Factory, gotta see them confessions. Oh sorry my son showed you his bare poopy ass; no, not Haku or Mom, the other one.
Good fun. Still cannot do Gimme Some. Maybe i never will. When is my training montage.
Almost good. If there was just one more hold on the face, instead of a grab bag for the lip.
The laydown start makes this way better. Quality off the ground mantle to set up in the original line. Borderline V2/V3, hard to tell as a mantle muncher like me.

Logging so i don't forget this memory of epic failure. Woo found a crystal peanut that made the first move crux actually not bad. I did the top for Woo since I didn't think I had a chance and I wanted my Woo to doooo, but I really did have a chance! Was proud of myself for actually pulling on that micro crimp! After Woo sent, i missed the choo choo but i stuck the pod next go and was cruising on the easy pre-rehearsed top when the peanut gave up on life, and took with it my chances of sending. I plummeted to the ground a sad boy. First move literally felt 3+ grades harder without that crystal.
Another one I didn't log? Really? Also this is not V0.

Absolutely not a warm up, yeowzers. What a cruxy pull on. Took me and Woo each several attempts to even pull on. It was so hard that woo gave up. Cool knobbos after the first move but dam I will not do that again. Amazing temps, sub par bodies and buttholes. We out here to celebrate our son tho and we did that.

This on the other hand was super cool! Did I mention the crew!? The crew was Me, Woo, Munin, Tim annnnndddd drum rolll, the one the only Nathaniel coming our of self impsoed outdoor retirement. So stoked to see that guy today it was a BLAST. This climb was quite fun and way better than Operation Phoenix. A big fun move then solid holds to top her.
I definitely did this years ago but i didnt log!? I always log. Tis enjoyable. Nathaniel's face was better

Again Kaya for RR leaves something to be desired.  I cant tell almost anything on this boulder. This has probably been done but I gave it FA energy and I'm taking it. On the corner between Graveyard Rave and Book of Nightmares there is an obvious sloper feature and two juggy opposing sidepulls. There is a 6 foot pit between boulders in teh landing but if you accidently steal some tri fold Metolious' the fill that pit nicely. Start on the opposition and do some fun slopers into a crux reach to a good left hand hold. From there just don't break the choss. Magdalene and I had an awesome pre valentiens day date then woke up at 5 am to drive out to redrocks to see our friends. 13/12 attendance is pretty good. Love you all. <4.5 hour drive to RR, > 7 hour drive home. Bloody weather.

This thing is actually phenominal. Quite easy but its a gorgeous standalone rock with a great view of the desert and canyons. Holds feel solid (solid enough) and the low angle lets you bull down not out. Glad we got the crew on this. Gurdev and Munin really needed that days climbed metric. Also fun to see everyone work Murpheys Law. Too bad that thing has a sketch top bc bottom is fun.
A silly variation to the classic. You really should just run the classic 20x .
Meh this one was not really worth doing. It is a bit less tall tho.
Honestly pretty good. Takes the best of "go for this time" and enjoys the top of "in our time". points.

The stand is honestly pretty good... at least 75% of the climb anyway. Jug mid way up is rad, and the next big reach is also good, but then it kinda peeters out to poop. A chunk crumbled in my hand on the top believe it or not. You should believe it. Nice workin this with da team while the rest of the crew fights for their freedom.
I guess I sat start where Marshalls Law Sit starts. Interesting.

This was really really hard for me and finding beta was tricky. It felt like small box and crimping much too hard, which is tough with these greasy sausages that are out of practice. Nice working with drew. Fun when i still get to climb with him and work thru beta!

I cant believe how bad the Kaya for Red Rock is. Makes me sad. I think this is the East Face of the Trade Center boulder, in which case this is actually pretty good. A ool techy face lock off leads to jugs up high. Proud of Gurdev for smashing this and proud of Munin for doing the crux and being content without topping out. Sometimes its harder to recognize you should not do something. Oh also shout out ryans cleeeaaannn send. Also shout out my amazing vocal cues to help drew top this beast.
Again no idea if this is correct bc Kaya is less than ideal. When looking at the Trade Center from Freedom Fighter this is teh juggy left arete. A bit friable but definately climable
Obviously I couldn't.

You could use some subtle tricker with the slopers out left, or realize teh hold you are going to is basically a finger bucket. Go big and love it. Another one in within 10 feed that is stout one movers. Good fun though, perfect distance for my dimensions to not have to cut, would be cooler if a cut was forced.
OOOOOOOpf. That is a hard one move for V2. Holds are pretty cool but its a short one mover. Still felt good to stick
Also with some cool holds but short and stout. Sloper is cool, and move to the lip is obvi cool.
Getting around that intimal angle change and into the libe back dihedral proper is no joke! meh!
Meh. Crack is already meh but then you must intentionally leave the obvious line. Soooo a bit forced. It is a bit exposed but the holds are good.

I cant believe that gate closed so early in the season. Means I had to go the extra mile (several) to get any data. ooph. And with all the rental prep and out of state move its a miracle i even made it out here. Biked from the gate all the way out here today sans pad. This thing looked liek crap but actually climbed okay! Some cool holds made up for its bad asethetics.
#35 Star wars Topo. Holds are kinda neat on this one! for how gritty and chossy the other side of the boudler is its nice to grab some real holds. And they are crystaly knobs which is neat
#34 Star Wars. Frictiony and gritty and chossy and maybe fun. Then again maybe not. It goes for sure no doubt. I scratched my right pec

Wow. That top section is nuts. Nice V0 slab gets you up there then you have no choice but to actully sack up for the top moves. There are exactly the right holds but its quite terrifying to pull yourself off the stand able ledge.
This climb is way more rad when you are psyching yourself up for second pitch. Enjoyable slab with some high feet
Easy Run n Jump.

This was kind of gross. I could barely pull on.  Based on the guidebook description it was very hard to determine but i used the only obvious high right crimp, something nearby for the left and pulled on with low feet then derped to the better slopey hold.
Woof. Those are some big huecos. But this climb is kind of silly. Its like 3 feet tall.
This was fun! good seam and an unnecessarily food knob/jug in the seam near the top which was aweseom.

Did it twice. Once i sat on the heel and reached our right to a nice sidepull. The second time i tried to go direct up the arete. both go. Using the sidepull is way more enjoyable, although slightly easier. I definitely took my shirt off and forgot it here so if you find it, give it to Kevin and maybe kevin will get it to me.
I joked with Kevin and Woo that if this was mineral king i would have had these in the book.... they were already in teh Black guidebook lol. Small but not the worst.

I would liek to remind people that anytime you hear loaf, you are going to expect it to be horizontal. No one puts their bread vertical. Anyway, when i finally foud this climb it climbed better than i expected.
That big overhang is mouthwatering, too bad its not climable,. This is kinda fun tho.
Very nice Ms Pancake. Features up higher feel very nice. Obvious slab line.
Nicely placed Zzzxxxenos!

Whoa!! if this thing got all the shit cleaned out of it it mgiht be kinda fun. Its liek isntantly no fall (not no fall but really woudl rather not fall ) zone. Remember i biked 8 miles out here with no pads so im ready for the worst. Anyway this was number 31 in the old guide. Unnameds are sad, Gets spooky fast but all the holds are there.

Forced. Do not use the detached block. Sit start with hands akwardly low on the big jug, because we are off routing the detached block you must hoold tension as you reach/lunge to the left arete. Once there work up to the top.
This was actually quite good! Enjoyable
Awesome starting hold! Start sitting on the opposing side pulls, and work your way straight up to the slightly slopy arete.
Big holds.
Twas enjoyable, starting feed were a bit hard
Cool feature for the namesake. Def real easy.
Start on the hollow tongue and continue up hollow holds the whole way up. Movement is ncie but hollowness leaves something to be desired.
Silly and small but thats boulderin!
Climb the center of the obvious double notched boulder. Climb straight up the unfortunately firable holds aiming for the notch. P cool

Inaugural Leavenworth trip!! Me and Maggie drove the ONE HOUR drive to Leavenworth and did a short few hours of rock touchin. Man this is surreal to have one of my Destination Crags now become my main crag. Stoked on my move.
That was actually kinda fun. Worth doing mantle at the V0 level! enjoyable gripz
Silly indeed!

I knew i was weak so it was the perfect day to tick this classic off the list! So far down the road for one V0 but it is good fun. Sadly a bit contrived bc the glory line stays on the face but you can easily wrap around the arete at basically any moment. Good Jugs. Did the sit as well for extra rock touches today! So excited to start our new life together Munin!!!!!!

Woof. Its probably actually V2 but another one of those easy climbs with a sub par landing that make it feel harder. Cool feature obvious feature. If the landing was flat here people would do it way more.
Had to do this for name alone. I may have missed something but this felt nails for V1.
not even meh.
Everywhere I climb, there something that reminds me of him. Small, but modest.
This deserves more love. Its small and in the shadow of the inspiring Rib boulder, but fun climbing is fun climbing regardless of size. You start on a Jug, bust a move, then mantle.
Why does the different composition rock scare me so much. I know its gotta be trial tested but i thought i might rip and plummet.
Yup being tall helps. Cool starting holds and final hold. Middle ones are not as intuitive.
Mantle is indeed lovely. Feel a tiny bit exposed but this is just what a mantle should be.
As far as easy lip traverses go its aight.
Meh

Handful of goes. Left heel beta made it feel even as easy as V5 when the heel sticks. Crux is for sure first left hand move to the higher roof crimp. Cool grips, fun movement. Me likey. First RDO Levvy session. Can't wait believ emy RDO will virtually always be a quality climbing day.
Sharp for end of day. The cyrstal holds are cool.

Finally found Fern Gully thanks to Kaya. Moudra GPS and Chubby Fairy GPS's are off tho. Anyway, knew why this was called mini mountain instantly, good name. Total V point count for the day is 70! nice work fam. These zeros really add up!
The rare enjoyable VB. Makes for a entry level handless climb.
This was super fun! And it was nice and crisp chilly from the big boulders holding that precious cold air. Short sweet!
Odd start but managing that bulge was enjoyable. Face is easy so its fine despite the pit landing.

This might just be a box thing but this felt incredibly hard. It is a one move climb, but that was a lot of effort and a low probability move. You aaaaare going to a really good hold but three points all withing a foot of eachother is not alot of wiggle room. I used double undercling on the edge with high right foot beta. I actually really enjoyed this, especially since it doesnt look like much. I'm giving a personal upgrade bc i had to try really hard. If it was soft more people would have done it.
I love a good jug start to a jug lip. Worth doing. Why do those calcaceous holds alwasy make me feel dirty inside?
A kinda cool feature, that just somehow doesn't feel that great. Could bail left at any moment, its kinda reachy, but its tall which is neat.
Good dihedrals are hard to come bu so i really enjoyed this. I wish there was a more natural stemmy finish but i just spanned after the initial stemming.
Really a quality V3. Fun holds, fun but straightforward movement, not too hard of mantle, and tall but not too tall. Will absolutely run this one back.
Its okay. More shady which is nice. Started higher than i was expecting, so basically a few left hand slabs is all she wrote.
I missed some holds and it felt kinda hard, but its enjoyable to squeeze a pickle from time to time.
So aesthetic and great movement up till the crux... then like what? Whats the cleanest way to do that? Still im a sucker for tall and pretty. Feels much more like V5.
Maybe better then the original? It is more direct. Plus I didn't need to do any funk matching. The jug out left is p-rad though. Worth doing both variations.
Its an obvious dihedral for sure. Stem or walk up.
Short but its a good feature.
Odd indeed! Funny little pull off the ground to a single move throw with nothing to help generate from the right hand. Then you kind of just dilly dally your way up.
What a lovely starting jug. Looks like there may be some hidden crimps above the lip bit ofc i did a natural mantle, no plastic surgery at all.
Cool starting move and crux hold. Top was not dirty and i enjoyed myself.

Yeah this needs more traffic; really quite good with rad holds. That textured pinch is awesome and the squeezy opening moves into slab is great. I did end up spanning pretty far to make the slab easier but i really enjoyed climbing this. Met Tobi at the top!

I loved this!! Such a technical move off a rad gaston. I love the body position to eek every ounce of force out of that gaston. So many right hand bumps. The entire climb is right hand bumps really lol. ALSO we popped Tobis outdoor cherry!! He officially an adventure cat now. He did so good!! apparently he doesnt like being too far from the car / road. He started freaking out when i went to Shaniqua and was leading me back down lol.
One okay move is all. Another good boulder spot for Tobi!! He climbed the boulder!! Good boy!

This slab was quite good. Kaya in Leavenworth has some oddities. Like how is there another line to the right of this one?! CBD Slab? I think thats a mistake.   Because of the way the descriptions are written i actually did a climb BETWEEN the The Joint and 420 slab bc i thought 420 Slab was CBD slab. yeeks-a-yyuk. ALSO talking about gripes... i tried "Stoner Slab" bc it was listed as V4 in Kaya. egads. Its a project in the book and oof i spent an hour+ trying it assuming i was missing something.
Literally between 420 Slab and The Joint.... did it bc kaya deceaved me just like that guys dad in braveheart.

This was crazy hard. Kaya 4s knocking me down today. Fist Stoner Slab then this. When i got back to service i realized this broke, which makes sense how hard it felt. Also i stayed true to the kaya line and didn't wrap onto the slab at all which made the last move scary hard and gross. It is tall tho and i like that. Might be harder than 5 this way, so maybe rocking onto the slab is the way to go.
That drilled pocket really is where you woudl want a hold. Instead you gotta reach further to a worse hold. lol. My footage was not aimed quite right, that’s what a shoe tripod sometime do.

Not sure if Kaya is right and its Jon or the guidebook is right and its John. Either way the real Jo(h)n definitely envisioned this climb climbing out right followign the arete. That woudl be rad. may need to come back for that. As it is the escape out left was kinda cool.
#13 in the guide. Its barely a climb but it goes so i must do.
Feels hard then you realize you just need to trust those damn smears. Also finger stack in the high crack was mighty painful. But it held!
felt hard at first but its just rather precise and delicate... except that last move!
Finally got her to squee but it took lots of patience, trickery and just raw talent. Remember to make use of those monkey arms and get the nipples involved too. She was pleased. As was I.
I did not enjoy this very much
This thing is pretty rad for an unnamed in the book. Definitely good fun. Rad underclings for the left hand and nice honker at the top.
Thats slab climbing. Did it from a sit bc that starting foot block jug was cool. Interesting pocketey crimp thing. Number 6 i the guide.
Fun. Honestly harder mantle than some of the harder lines lol. Loving how many good features are on this bloc

First Go after the stand. It is a bit worse than the stand which is sad bc that starting block hold is aesthetic, feet just aren't quite right. Nice meeting Kitty the dog and their parents at this climb.
Blew my cruiser no fall on this boulder. Certainly the hardest line on the boulder. not bad, not great. Kinda nice overall for the variety compared to the rest of the climbing on this blok
I enjoyed this a lot! A few ways to climb it but quality holds and quite enjoyble. Maggie playing pupeteer on this and finally bagging was rad. So glad i saved this boulder for a day with you!
Good, but incredibly hard for V1. Definitely V2 IMO. Solid and fun deadpoint on an easir problem is p-cool. Maggie tryna grow some wings. good hops BB.
Honestly not much harder than the stand, but its the full natural line which is nice. Plus that starting flat ledge is too perfect to not want to touch.
Essentially the same as Maniacal Moray.

While none of the lines on this boudler individually might get the coveted recommend, the sheer quantity of enjoyable climbs in 0-3 on this single boulder is incredible. Another one that was really fun watching Munin micro beta and make progress. Lets get in that Anime Training Montage arc!

This was unexpectedly awesome. Landing isn't ideal but some rad holds. Jugs up gorgeous face. Only detractor is some of those holds seem a tad thin for a high consequence climb. They felt solid but look thin.

oooooof. That was CRAZY hard. But its also one of those where subtle differences in where you start make a huge difference. The obvious start to me is left hand on the blocky undercling near the arete, then right hand on the lowest chunky under cling  near hip height with the thumb catch. I wasn't able to link it from there so i started with my right hand ~4 inches higher on that same undercling feature. I WAS able to do the moves from the lower start I described but it added a surprising amount of effort. Fun but honestly should probably be upgraded to V5, and maybe give more specifics on which underclings to start on.

I REALLY enjoyed this one. First impression seemed a bit silly with the easy escape out left, but there are some genuine jugs up this rig. Start on a cool block at the base of the dihedral with well placed footholds and enter jug territory! Ducking the wee tree is annoying but other than that its all good!
Honestly this seemed way too forced and not that good. Hired goons is the way to go. Also really not much harder.

Im getting railed by these V4s!! Wowzers. That fetch doggie was very cute. Another nonintuitive climb. The obvious starting hold is too high to "sit start" but there are some holds below that soooo i did manage a sit start with arms fully extended. It SHOULD just start on that obvious hold at the base of the lip. I went left some before executing a difficult press. not bad, but not great.

Almost amazing. It's too bad the crux isn't a tad easier for consistency. Bottom movement is so wonderful and holds are lovely. I found a few ways to do that big move but i really wish there was just a right facing edge to make a nice heel move. Anyway, can't fault god for what the rock be.. actually we can fault god, why not? Whatw the big guy gonna do. Fun climb, and this boulder is a lovely easier boulder for outdoor / levy introduction! Recommend this boulder as a whole!
An excuse to do those fun bottom moves again and get an extra point! Yes please.
Short but  still enjoyable! Cool horizontal ledges with an nice leg squeezer start. A tree recently fell behind this boulder!

This was nails. Maybe in cold dry temps this actually feels like V4 but that was some serious effort. No one will complain with the upgrade to V5. Cool moves though on some unobvious slopers. Id love to see how someone else figures out this line.
New tree fall makes it so you need to dodge a tree branch while climbing! Kind of fun with this variant lol. If anyone brings a saw of some sort could easily chop this dangler.

I used a knee pad but now I see it’s not needed for the first move. Le sigh. Fun moves. I did really like the left hand under clings. Normally I hat under clings but these felt nice in my handos. I had a biff from the top right as my left hand hit the lip bc my right hand wet fired. Thank god I’m a three syllables athlete. I love having levy so close now.

I had a good time. Earlier this week I was throwing my self at nasty boy. Ooooof that’s a toughie. I may have been tired or wet or tired and wet bc that 4 felt harddd.  Anyway this is solid, cool start moves of bushy into easier top.
Welp it’s kelp.

Awesome line. I saw a bear up above hilltop. What was I doing up there you might ask? EXPLORING! I like rocks 🤤. It scared me an I ran down to the litter box (can’t wait to come try that one). Not as scared as that time with Shirley tho.

I’m confused reading this description vs the Kaya description. Who cares. I saw a tower and I climbed it end of story. I was v surprised I sent in only a handful of goes. Those first two moves felt ooooph. I audibly said crimp crimp crimp and well I crimp crimp crimped that right hand good. Amazingly I used a toehook and an upside down heel hook on the bulge. I started sitting with right hand on undercling feature left squeezing a shitty guy on the arete.

This was not very good. Looks promising but all the left facing holds with a left facing foot even a good left food feels me no likely and the top holds are hollow as hell. Speaking of hard, crispy duck is right forked.

Jimmy must crimp good and be real technical bc this woudl be real hard for 5+. 7 is good, ill go with that. Felt good to cruise up this one today after having trouble on those wee crimps a few weeks back. Mighty technical and real good. Classically Munin never sees my sends.
Munin don't you dare slip from the top. Use the good feet bb. Fun for Vb.
Start squatting just left of Dan Akryod and navigate up and left usign the cool undercling side pul for some wee squeeezing.
If someone put the effort in to clean this it would actually be quite fun. As it is it’s a bit sketch. Crack holds are all good n large. Feet are hidden under moss.
Not that bad and not that hard. Standard slab honestly p fun. Ran it once in cruisers then ran it back for footy which of course I aimed poorly and missed the important bits. Oh well.

A good excuse to do two parts of two good boulder problems again. Dont like that annoying sloper on the rail?! Who would, fuck the lemons and bail, go left into the dihedral for an easier extra point.
Another one better than I expected. A bit hard first move or two then just lovely horizontal edges. Maggie was impressed by my new age ladder shoe tripod setup
This was way better than I expected. Holds are awesome. Starts high and only a few moves but good fun

What a lovely climb! With this I finally stage cleared this boulder - lots of good content here. The other day i was crimped out and having trouble with the entry, today the crimps felt v-casual but the slopers felt tough! Turns out there was some micro in my left hand which made the toe hooks better oppose the hand. Lovely body tension on those toes! I was stoked that i opted for the foot lead on the sloper moves. Could see V8 but im definitely taking 9, I think a bit condition dependent. Oh also i realized that the amazing patina crimp is actually glued which is a bit sad, but at the same time preserves this great line. Oh the silly rules we make.  Tobi on his second adventure cat day! keep him away from dang it holes!

Better than I expected and would be even better if someone wire-brushed the slab. Start same as Mountain Man but go up and a teensy left when pulling onto the slab. Easiest line on the boulder, the 4s on this boulder are so hard for 4.

This is so close to being amazing. The uniqueness is all time but climbs a bit awkwardly - still absolutely worth doing. If this wasn't off on its own (with pitted) it would definitely be quite popular. The other detractor is despite the awesome large features the crux uses a small sharp crimp. Tobi was getting a bit restless at this point, darn kitty trying to go into every dang it hole he sees.

Wow when seasons decide to shift them temps do crazy things. Two days ago was still nice but today, oooophhh. I got so dehydrated my uvula lengthened. That shit feels weird as hell.  Good stair stepper workout with my stack today: 2 large organics + organic blubber + ladder. Ath-e-lete. Anyway this thing is facing south so quite sunny. Landing is a bit bushy and slopey but doable. The only left hand edge is really high, i could barely reach it with just a blubber at the start. Hard pull on then honestly pretty enjoyable climbing. Only a few moves but nice controlled squeezes up to an incredibly picturesque mantle. Felt soft, so could be V5 but soft 6 is always good. I tried Solstice some and that thing feels insane, like way harder than V9. Like I was using the detached rock at the bottom and it still felt hard. If anyone has betas for it let me know.
(PRNF) I had a ath-e-letic fall on my first go. The video is great. So glad im an ath-e-lete. Jump start to teh good edge, then jump to the lip. Fun, gimicky also not in kaya.

Wowzers pulling on was rough. Was that right hand always that small? Its one of those holds that looks like its recently crumbled but maybe its always been uncomfy and not enough space for these mighty sausages? Normally for climbs like this I liek to be able to dead hang before tossing the feet high, but on this boy I could not do that. I literally could not true deadhang those start holds. Luckily the act of pulling on distributes your weight right so you can slap that heel up. Once the heel is up the climb is basically over. Awesome crimp edges our right and finishign with a flat jug liek that is always a good time. Plus that view. lovely. Thanks chase for the phone call and remote spot.

bad slopers good feet good fun. I think starting with the jump start into compression then moving left would be slightly better than awkwardly stating with that left facing sloper and needing to campus your feet up. But both are good. Dealers choice bc the meat of the climb is those gnarly slopers. Very satisfying to hit that good hold on the lip after riding the slip n slide holds on your journey.
Give some love to the low grade lowballs! The aesthetics on this are definitely lacking but the holds feel nice and the movement was rather good. I may put Munin on this eventually.

(PRNF) That mantle is too perfect. How is this not in Kaya. I was drooling as soon as I walked up.  surprisingly easy for being so protruded without obvious holds above the lip. You never really know how hard a mantle is until you slap that leg up and get pushin.  Really doubt this could be an FA bc it looked like someone had a landing.. but maybe taht was just for security on Goldeneye? Regardless that menu music slaps and deserves a shout out whenever Goldeneye is mentioned. Also this makes Goldeneye contrived since stright up be easier... just sayin =P. Good fun.

This was both harder and more enjoyable than I expected. On first look it feels really sad that you cannot sit start the Arete, but the traverse in actually feels natural and interesting. Interseting top out with the rock behind you. Theres a obvious project on the boulder immediately to the left which almost looks cool.

I love the data on a boulder like this. People flock to this line like the salmon of Capistrano. Sockeye be fish so the Dumb n Dumber reference is gold. Goldeneye (supposed to be easier) just to the right has 3 ascents on Kaya, this has over 80. The fun part here is what makes this so popular? Is it softness? Is it the closeness to the ground? Did it go viral on some influencers account? Is it the interesting movement? The world may never know. Good fun regardless and I'm glad people be touching rock whatever the reason.

Crazy day and an absolute blast.  Start w/ Pokemon Go Community Day in town w/ Frigibax—we got a Hundo! Zev met Mags n I for the stroll and ice cream then straight to Upper Bonds. I carried 3x big organics and the ladder 💪, Grecian God at your service. Immediately pulled on Across the Grain. Woof, no hiking points at all, some of the holds must  have gotten worse over time—LOTS OF CHOSS  up here. Split my left index on my 5th burn—brutal. Moved to Rain Dance (incorrect Kaya GPS) for an easy Days Climbed Metric but that was also tough for the grade, a few hollow holds to boot. Looked at Bury the Hatchet (looks awesome) then headed down.

Explored Bonds and lots I wanna try! Shaken Not Stirred has been struck by Concussion Royal and is now an entirely different climb! We finished at the Fridge playin on classics. Zev bagged Center but was too beat to wrangle Left. Even w/ tape I repeated Center+Left+Right which was sweet. I’m gonna make it an annual thing to climb @ da solstice! So cool to be to 10pm and not need lights.

Incredible day and so glad I was able to send for days climbed metric to regale you all with this comment 🙇‍♂️. So good to see you Zev ☺️❤️
flat ledges were cool. Good fun.

It baffles me that this line is not on here but the illogical extension further left is. The crux moves into Around the World does seem pretty cool, but its way more obvious to climb to and topout at the apex where the good holds are instead of cutting left with a big span and bad slopers.

I don't like when descriptions tell you start as low as you can, on a feature that goes on forever. I bet the wide boyz could smeagol under the boulder and climb the roof section into the OG making it V8+.  I think this needs at least 2 starts for consistency. Starting at the angle change did feel about V2. I started lying down in a a tough lie back and struggled to get to that angle change notch. It felt more like 5. But maybe this is graded liek the OG Bachar Cracker in which case it must be sandbagged, them be the rules. Suuuper cool feature.
My favorite on this boulder! I can SMELL 100. Also the softest on the boulder.
Horizontal roofs with jugs are a recipe for a fun V5. That final shelf mantle felt nails but pretty sure theres an easier way i just didn't want to blow my flash.  Good fun,

For how many holds look broken on this is till felt in the ballpark of V6. Movement wise it was actually pretty good but unfortunately this climb has an odd ick factor. My timing was pretty good to wind up here when the drizzles came!
This is super cool!! Undercut roof all full of jugs? Me likey. I did a kind of gross body campus drag but pretty sure are better ways, but I'm on a mission.

Have I ever climbed through a bush like this before? This climb would be such a lovely and easy zero if you didnt have to navigate around/thru a literal bush. Not sure if it counts as dabbing... probably but.. its a dab of life!
Finally scraping the barrel in the final push for 100. I did not love this climb. Supposed to be V1 but top out crux was kinda hard and the landing isn't great.
This one is actually okay, still felt hard even for V2.

The boulder you fall on if you fall off the top of "Shrimp Travel". Theres a gool arete that arises out of a dang it hole. Would be super cool if it wasnt a dab nightmare but its suprisingly still cool for teh few mores you can squeek. Start with the increduble obviouls shelf for your left hand and right hand on the arete above the touching boulders. smear left in the dang it hole, throw right heel up, bump right hand to a good pinch then slap that left heel up without dabbing (sadly hard not to dab), which lets you grab the honker undercling/sidepull. Power through that sucker to the top. I wanna be a shrimp >.<. I would have been too if the sun didnt absolutely blast that darn starting hold. I shall be back!!

In my head I was going to flash everything I touched. No mater how many times that proved not to be the case, I kept believing it. Here is one time belief was the leaf. This is almost cool. If you do do it, please wire brush the top first, its insanely dirty. The "Pocket Knife (of Mineral King)" of Leavenworth. It's taller and easier yet two grades harder!

I DID IT. My second 100 V point day ever, both of em in Leavenworth!! Last time was in 2018, and now I'm a WA native. That ended up being a real effort. Cant believe I decided to do it on a day where my left index was still freshly ripped. big shoutout to my skin. Only hit 100 including the "non documented" climbs I did so give this an asterisk if you must but please don't, i deserve a high five. My "most likely not FAs "were good. This climb would be good if thoroughly cleaned, as is its a bit scarier than it needs to be.

This has to have been done before right!? Too good not to have been. Theres a bush in the rock and you jump like a bird hence the all star name. God has not taken my bird and my bush. He hath given me great boulders. Startin' the wonderful day here!!!

Whoa. Crazy to think this was proposed as more than V7! Great climb and agree its worth the hike, I didn't need the ladder tho lolz. When the new chaos area popped up on Kaya I was so stoked to come and have a savage volume day. Weather people promised me clouds all day but oof chaos theory of weather proved incorrect. Sun is no bueno. Dude that hueco undercling sloper is so unique and rad! Shall I am for 100 V points today? That is the question.

Start on the friable crimp with feet out right on the good starting complex of the OG. Join that line and keep climbing. Excuse to climb it again woot woot. Worst part of this is that it makes you realize that the start hold AKA awesome foot for the undercling sequence of the OG is hollow and flexy. Sad.
This was really hard for V4. It's also not as obvious and kinda "fizzles" out for the top. Points thooooo. Some good start as the OG harder line.

Am I warm after this? Not really, but more climbs on a rock is nice.  also whoops. Added this grade with number "1". is that like an escalator? I cent even fathom what a "1" would be in this crazy difficulty scale.

Super cool for looking like an afterthought next to Munsters. Awesome starting feature complete with a good foot. Only detractor is how dirty the top is but an inspired someone coudl clean it and this would level up to a fantastic V2.
Wow also hard. But rapid fire point hoarding might have something to do with that.

Wow I love that this isn't even called traverse.. you an always traverse more lolz. This climb is almost cool, and you have to give it style points for having a jug that big, but you have to also remove points for choss and dab potential.
This was decent.

Dang, this is cooler than it looked in pictures / videos! Such a rad mid boulder arete. Perfect foot for opposing the arete too. First time to this boulder is crazy, i wont spoil it (too much), but i was really wondering how a climb was called "the slot" without a slotty hold. I though maaaybe that concavity by the arete was a "slot", that is not it.

Reeeeaaaallly wanted to flash. Flashing is the best way to get good exchange rates on skin to points, or get a violation for indecent exposure. Got to the last move first go but I didn't tape my left index which I absolutely obliterated last week and had a mental battle trying to convince my body to just stick a DP. My body refused which ironically cost more skin. That right hand move is harder than I expected.

I did not like this as much as the others. Wrap around a bit awkwardly with worse feet than I wanted. Sun is starting to peek on me and I'm getting spent. Fingers already starting to hurt but i gots so many more points i need to hit a hundoooo. All three of these were harder top outs that i expected.

Shnikeys!! this was fun. Fun AND in the shade. Thank god. I was really losing steam thinking my 100 V Point day was in jeopardy, but this had a nice breeze gushing from below which put literal life in my sails. While recovering my health bar, cloud sfinally rolled in like a crying gift from god. I really don't see how this face is "oddly triangular". There is a cool triangle foot and triangle hold, but thats it. huh. This had one of the subtlest heels I've used in a while, stoked to put it together. Starting left hand sloper is nice to hold.
Tricky little arete move!
Would be a great zero with one more hold. Harder than all the ones around here. Not bad just mis-graded. No body would mind V2 for this little guy.
Enjoyable! Fun smattering of good holds.
Decent slab. Haven’t climbed much good slab in levy yet so this was fun!
Really cool start hold and interesting tech. Second half was harder than the first move tho. First time I went as straight up as possible, ignoring all holds out left.
Different enough it deserves a separate line, PLUS I deserve more points. From the same square blocky hold go straight left into a cool gaston sequence instead of up.
Agree with Stella here. Not the "4A" part, but that this is an awesome guy. Good variety of holds, good rock and good movement.

Cool line even with out the flake. Looked like it might be a technical toughie but that left hand crimp is better than it looks. A bit spanny but good incuts and not too bad. Good send train with my unknown shoe filming partner in crime.
Whats with Stella grading these things less than VB? As Jason said this thing is indeed short and sweet. All very comfortable ledges complete with a nice starting foot. Would do again.
Start on the far left of the Touch of Grey ledge then work up and left through interesting gaston and crimp. Probably not an FA but i dont see any info.
Very pleasant indeed!! Amazing ledges make for a good time. Not sure what the recommended down climb is but I had Munin do the small jump on the north side.
meh

Would be much better with a flat landing but that was cool. My beta is wildly different than the previous video. Mine involves pulling pretty hard on a sharp left hand which was a bit of a detractor, but otherwise good fun.
Yah this is a goodie, plain and simple. I promise to do this everytime I'm at Egg rock from now on. Keep me honest!
Somehow I couldn’t see the good left hand side pull on the flash go and was squeezing juice out of them slopers. Second go I grabbed the correct hold and it all made sense. Good stuff.
Harder than Plumbers Crack. Good fun.
Worth a quick stop on the Ship of Fools boulder! Nice big starting ledge then bunch of options to get to the lip; crimp or push or jump then a classic mantle.
Cool holds!

Holy cow. I assumed this was just a big huck but I couldn't find the right feet to generate properly. I was about to give up when I decided to try feet first. It was definitely MY original thought... neither Bryan Woods nor mntmonkey had this thought before me. Not documented on the internet or anything. MY original transcendental thought. Crazy satisfying when I finally slammed those feet way up there and got fully inverted. Highest vertical distance I've placed toe hooks. Thank god these abs are good for something. Is this climbing? Def morhp but i was pretty stoked when I unlocked.

Man the integrity of these v17 climbers got me feeling obligated to invalidate my flash over a small dab. Foot hit pads on the rip, pretty sure it didn't effect end result but it was 100% a dab. Speaking of dabs, why is grabbing a chalk bag off the ground not a dab? Ive always wondered that. This climb was enjoyable but probably not V7 and the image in Kaya does not match the description. This area has some funk going on but pretty sure that's because THIS boulder *recently* rolled down and struck Sean Connery. Don't believe me, look closely at "Shaken, not Stirred". No idea how recently but I feel like within the alst 2/3 years. I started lower than the only video left hand on the obvious start and right hand on a crimp on around teh corner on the face, first move into the obvious crimp jug right hand. Body tension to navigate around the head rock was actually cool and added to the movement even if a bit un pure. Anyway, fingers were hurting and it look like 5 more tries after the dab-flash.

Wowzers. Climbing is made up and the points don't matter. This one *might* actually be an FA? Only saying that bc its quite contrived and dumb, but oh i loved it. I think this line might truly be what Kaya was describing when they described "Concussion Royale" but that has evolved. To the right of Shaken not stirred is a flaring crack and a pit. Lower yourself into the pit and start on the flaring crack at the horizontal edge and let the "fight the dab fest" begin. After a move or so cut right into the cool blocky sloper, then up and right through the sharp crimp pinch to the low lip. So close to the ground that i had to use a worse part of the sloper and full crimp it just to get my elbow a millimeter off the ground. Quite contrived bc if both boulders are on u wud realistically keep going left to the bigger holds before cutting right, but climbing has never been about logic. live your own adventure!

Heres a question? Can you "re-flash" a boulder that has undergone metamorphosis? This boulder is NOT the same as when I did it back in 2018. At some point recently it was struck by "Concussion Royale" and it is no longer possible to go right. More like "Shanked, Stirred and Shattered!". The rock split and there is a new crack jug making this even easier. It took me forever to find this line based on the Kaya image and thats because the image is out of date! There is a literal new boulder smashed up against Sean Connery (who wouldn't want to be smashed up against Sean Connery?). Still worth doing if only to appreciate how savage nature can be; appreciate its power. In our fleeting lives we don't see drastic changes like this too often so go up and inspect for yourself.

Absolutely gorgeous. So gorgeous that even though this has a few rock quality problems, a tiered landing, and some height dependent moves, it STILL deserves 5 stars. Thats how gorgeous it is. I started at the lowest tier, which took a few tries; from the classic start it's certainly a bit easier, but when you see a nearly 25 foot arete you don't skip the first 6 feet.  Unbelievable when the Gods collaborate to place a gorgeous boulder like this with such a good view, well either Gods or just a sweet coincidence of RNG. All praise the RNG goddess.

This was kinda hard. I could see temps coming into play but it was probably harder that 1000 Words, albiet significantly safer lol. Whats with all the ellipses in these descriptions? I started both hands on the jug just below the crack the worked into the crack underlings and ultimately them slopers. Final tick before I can run the gambit and hopefully not run into any bears on the trail blaze toward edge of tomorrow.

Munin told me to bring bear spray today. I forgot. Naturally I ran into a bear shortly after unpacking at this boulder. Normally Black bears aren't too scary but this boy (or girl) made eye contact, took a few steps toward me and started huffin. I was proper scared and was prepping contingency plans. I think the "best" was scurrying to the top of the boulder and using my ladder to win king of the hill. Thankfully the bear backed down, unfortunately tho it went down the trail i came up. Decided to blaze a new trail like Miguel and Tulio toward Upper Bonds and the fridge. This climb is awesome, every feature is so cool Only downside is a bit reachy and the boulder on the landing. Obvious starting jug, then rad triangular feature and finally big move to lip. fun!

Another worthwhile line on the Draccus boulder. The left arete. As low as I started the first move bumps this up the roughly V3 but the rest is pretty easy so hard to grade.  Has an incredible down pull jug that is basically unneeded but its always good to touch jugs, so noice. Saying "Beary Beary Beary Beary Beary" on repeat. Honestly the hike down to "Edge of Tomorrow" and down through the Bonds was honestly not that bad. I kind of think I prefer that hike that the Kaya approved approach. I stumbled upon a big fire pit on my pathfinding, so definitely doable and done beore.

The hike to Upper Careno was brutal not gonna lie. I had a lot of factors going against me but I'm supposed to be a Grecian God: 2 big organics, a organic blubber and a ladder but the worst part was the humid heat and steep trail. Woof. Sections of loose dirt, and needed to use my hands a few times too. It took me a full hour and i had to take like 3 breaks. Maybe I've lost my touch. This is basically just as cool as the OG line, same great starting jug and triangle feature, but go big up and left instead. Stardew Valley sound track blasting full volume to protect me from more bears and calm me down.
Another meh. I did not do the hero traverse bc i did not clean the boulder past Marmot Crack and it was too dirty for me to want to risk it. I was pumped by that point tho. Fair climb description.
Marmot Boulder is meh. This climb is kinda cool but its the best thing on the boulder and its not that good. Hurrying so I can escape my bear fears.
Would be decent if not for the tight confines of the start. Nice that this face is east facing tho so you can catch evening shade.

Whoa, almost forgot I did this today bc it was pre bear. Cool interesting holds and movement. Biggest detractor is rock quality. There is a crimp jug above the lip that is quite good but feels like its gonna rip, I did not use it simply matched the sloper before moving right to the mantle.  Use at your own risk, or dont. Final mantle is super nice. Very hot and humit today, I hoping thats why everyhtign feels hard and its not that im a potato.

The horizontal rail is actually pretty cool on this. Its not a very pretty climb but at least its got that rail. I did it from the low crack sit which does bump the grade a bit but not too much. A bit dabby down there but not too bad.

This wasn’t as good as I was hoping. This whole boulder doesn’t have the best rock quality. I tried “fish and chips” for a bit and several holds broke on me. The arete obviously wont break but still. Also i ran into a huge rattlesnake walking between here and whip 😱. That’s was scary. Oh! A ton of logs are in the landing which probably make this climb less scary than it used to be. I should have drank more water 😵. I started squatting both hands on the arete undercling thing which added a bit of difficulty but not too much.

So many logs here!! 🪵 😱. I spent a good 1.5 hours moving logs and melting in the sun. I had to roll a 30ft log back a few feet to make enough space to do this climb. I got so engrossed into log moving- hot, sweaty and fun! It’s seriously crazy how many logs are here. I got a workout before even pulling on. Anyway, I was pleasantly surprised by this climb. The dab potential is annoying, but the moves were cool. The right hand pinch is kinda bad. I bet you could find a way to use the holds out left near other boulder.

Honestly pretty good. Start on a cool rail and use the obvious crimp for an enjoyable mantle. Worth doing for sure. Not sure if this fits the grashopper theme? Do grasshopper babies have 3 arms? Or am i missing somethign?
Perfect example of what  a 5 Star V Zero should be. Great rock, great landing, options. Will do this every time im in Beach Forest.
Honestly really good. Felt hard for V3 though. Also start is rather dubious. Started where it felt natural and it felt correct.

Yeah fuck this. Movement wise its actually pretty good but woof last move is hard because a few reasons including bad feet, but maily because that flak feels way too hollow. I climb alone a lot and I hate sketchy rock when I'm alone. Had to try extra hard to pull out not down as I went for the lip. Will not do again. Although for those of you who know me I will probably do that lower start at some point bc im insane. smh. Felt way harder than V3 imho.
Very enjoyable. First go but did it after the Fin. On hard slap our right but cool climbing.
Good fun. Will do low next time. Great rock quality.

The crux was harder than expected. Tried the super bump on the flash then tried a few betas to avoid the super bump only to realize that yes the super bump is the easiest if you gots the span. The rock is so odd in this area its like loaded with features which both detracts from the aesthetics and adds to it, that seems counter-intuitive but its true. Has both choss and bullet. Very confusing. This climb in particular is quite solid and is relatively long for a boulder which makes ir real fun. Not as scary as guidbook suggests. Im also suprised there are less "official" lines. Like there needs to be a "Get Up, Stand Up Direct" which goes straight up that left facing ramp. Climbing beach in summer is smart, ive been milking icicle for too long and being out of the sun was a blessing.

Its called Jumper so i jumped. Im taking things literally today. Took a few goes bc kept jumping too far right and it was bad. Fun movement but another hold that flexes a bit which detracts. Cant wait do do the terrible link up next time! Muhahahah. As a yump this felt quite hard for V3 but i guess nobody jumps anymore if they have the heights... which i do... but i still yumped.

Fantastic. First time I saw this on a video I was hooked. Climbs slightly worst than it looks but these aesthetic superstars always bring me joy to climb. Start is a bit dubious but true sit start with first slap to the horizontal jug is not too hard.

Woof. Let me explain myself. This climb is called "The Terrible" I assumed this implied the beta like, "oof that sloper is terrible, matching it would be devious". Not once did my neandertal brain even once consider using my considerable span to reach the crinmp from the good left hand. In my defense though, matching that sloper was sick. Cant wait to come back and link into Jumper.

dang! I was really prepping for the flash. I felt visualized and everything. Subtle flub on match led to slight flub on the big move. Ill take the second go. This thing is crazy rad. Such a gym problem with such friendly holds. "Wine bottle" pinch is stellar. Said pinch feels a teensy bit friable but looks solid. Sometimes being too good at mantling makes you do way harder mantles than needed. I assumed the mantle would be find and didn't scope it, so after sticking the big move I ended up out of the pooling.  Such a gym-esque boulder, and definitely one of the best V8s overall in Leavenworth. Threw left heel at the start which let me cross left hand directly to the pinch.
